| The Double Standard of Costumes
---
|
---
|
---
June is PRIDE Month. In celebration, [406 PRIDE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Eb2PQ3Ulhbag_SjLKEU5wa7oGguSWxJ9agjLnJvk9vjXij3CI3PtQavCq2FX97skGDvAVX-JyNWC5S7XHd2nNvBOZRwAeYua31jdPiOxFkYY96bSRBa_Rhd9RqG7s3BCrPA__KeAiaZviA9ZV_nmAw==&c=Aye2D0to3BrX8j6ZCPqGrta2z1EkPkDYLAicgeRcR_9s81zOUEgczg==&ch=s40ogJRFURzr7rBCdB06YMQhfoyaD6nHbdxSDbY4lu_beEIX1Bf_Qg==), a non-profit organization in Billings, MT, is hosting a private event at [ZooMontana](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Eb2PQ3Ulhbag_SjLKEU5wa7oGguSWxJ9agjLnJvk9vjXij3CI3PtQavCq2FX97sk9vLjC0NmrkVY4ppwEFXRdN8LY9nEVwEE1zvoetXCsKbYPrQQk4CdtwcoAzY3j447Spxcm1sTQHjDtxsz_K8XeA==&c=Aye2D0to3BrX8j6ZCPqGrta2z1EkPkDYLAicgeRcR_9s81zOUEgczg==&ch=s40ogJRFURzr7rBCdB06YMQhfoyaD6nHbdxSDbY4lu_beEIX1Bf_Qg==). The event is a Drag Story Hour and tickets are being sold for the event.
ZooMontana has now come under fire by Matt Rosendale.
Pictured alongside Matt Rosendale's tweet are images from some of the top grossing children's films. In some of these films, the love interests are not with humans and the hyper-sexualized characters are minors. Many of these movies can be checked out at local public libraries, are in the homes of many Americans, and millions of children know songs from the films by heart.
And, many of these films have been screened throughout the country during summer Movies in the Park programs.
I've been to a Drag Storytelling presentation and what I witnessed were caring folks in costumes reading children's stories to kids. I've witnessed the same at other presentations in public libraries, parks, schools, churches, theaters, and museums -- folks in costumes reading children's stories to kids. I've also seen it at world class amusement parks.
PRIDE events provide opportunity for the LGBTQ+ community to feel safe and accepted among people who love and celebrate their absolute worthiness of both. They also provide opportunity for people to learn about and from the LGBTQ+ community.
I support 406 Pride and ZooMontana. Both organizations provide wonderful, wonderful support for the citizens of Billings, tourism, visitors, the economy, and so much more.
Both organizations are outstanding.
In a world full of division, I hope we all take and MAKE opportunities to build bridges of understanding with those different from us.
******
Here is a sample of how Matt Rosendale has voted when it comes to laws related to the protection of vulnerable populations, including children:
VOCA (Victims Of Crime Act) Fix to Sustain the Crime Victims Fund Act of 2021 - No Protecting Our Kids Act - No Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022 - No Community Services Block Grant Modernization Act of 2022 - No Making emergency supplemental appropriations for assistance for the situation in Ukraine for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2022, and for other purposes. - No Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act - No Creating a Respectful and Open World for Natural Hair Act (CROWN Act of 2021) - No Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act of 2021 - No America COMPETES Act of 2022 - No Protecting Our Democracy Act - No National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 - No Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act - No PUMP for Nursing Mothers Act - No Women's Health Protection Act of 2021 - No John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021 - No Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2022 - No PFAS Action Act of 2021 - No Consumer Protection and Recovery Act - No INVEST in America Act - No Global Health Security Act of 2021 - No LGBTQ Business Equal Credit Enforcement and Investment Act - No Equal Access to Contraception for Veterans Act - No Protecting Older Workers Against Discrimination Act of 2021 - No Juneteenth National Independence Day Act - No Workplace Violence Prevention for Health Care and Social Service Workers Act - No Paycheck Fairness Act - No Farm Workforce Modernization Act of 2021 - No Removing the deadline for the ratification of the equal rights amendment - No Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2021 - Did Not Vote Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2021 - No Bipartisan Background Checks Act of 2021 - No Requires Certain Political Groups to Disclose Expenditures - No Appropriates Funds for the Teachers' Retirement System - No Expands Medicaid Eligibility- -No Appropriates Funds for State Employee Pay Raises - No Prohibits Same-Day Voter Registration - Yes Authorizes Concealed Carry of Firearms Without a Concealed-Carry Permit - Yes Increases Public Education Funding - No Amends Sexual Conduct Laws - No Oil and Natural Gas Revenue for Schools - No
Also:
Matt Rosendale was one of only seven Montana state senators to vote against strengthening Montana's Human Trafficking laws by allowing victims an affirmative defense and requiring perpetrators to register as sex offenders.
He was one of nine Montana state senators to vote against legislation to establish a special prosecution unit within the Montana Attorney General's office to handle sexual assault cases.
In the Montana State Legislature, he voted against expanding the availability of unemployment insurance to victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and stalking.
And, in the Montana State Legislature, he voted against $50,000 in funding to restore notifying victims of sex crimes when their attacker was released from prison.

******UPCOMING: Election Integrity Roundtables Across Wisconsin** ******Fond Du Lac County** Fond Du Lac County elected conservative Sam Kaufman for County Executive!
###
### **Weekend of Action**
Wisconsin GOP Victory was very successful in their door-knocking efforts during their Weekend of Action this weekend! **Monroe County Dairy Breakfast** Monroe County Republicans attended the Monroe County Dairy Breakfast to show support for local dairy farmers! ******Dodge County Dairy Breakfast** Dodge County Sheriff Dale Schmidt paid a visit to the county’s Dairy Breakfast!
###
****
### **Waukesha County Movie Nights**
### Waukesha County has been drawing in some impressive numbers at their movie nights – at least 800 people have shown up to watch documentaries centered around election integrity!
###

****
### **Trempealeau County Parade**
The Trempealeau County Republicans had a strong turnout for their Eleva Days Parade! ******Trempealeau County Candidate Meet and Greet** Trempealeau County met with Rep. Jesse James, Rep. Treig Pronschinske, Karen Hurd, and Dave Estenson at Osseo Rod & Gun Club!
###
### **Trempealeau County Fundraiser**
Trempealeau County put on a great fundraiser at Champions for Dave Estenson for 31st Senate. Pictured above is the Trempealeau County “triple threat”: Derrick Van Orden, Treig Pronschinske, and Dave Estenson! **Winnebago County Pints and Politics** Conservatives in Winnebago County met last week at Finn n’ Feather in Winneconne to discuss the pressing issues facing Wisconsin!
###
### **Dane County Dairy Breakfast**
Team Barry and the rest of the Dane County Republicans at the Dane County Dairy Breakfast!
###
### **Outagamie County Flag Day Parade**
The Republican Party of Outagamie County was spotted at their Flag Day parade in patriotic gear to show their love for our country! **Monroe County Butterfest Parade** Monroe County Republicans gathered at the Sparta Butterfest parade to show their support for local Republicans and Derrick Van Orden! **Waukesha County** The Waukesha County Republicans sold patriotic apparel at the June Maxwell Street Days this weekend to get their community ready for the 4th of July! ******Barron County** The Barron County Republicans had an incredible turnout at the Rice Lake Aquafest parade!

name: Pro Life Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zq1hcbh98n0omh83epq894hk65611uecklrproh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9g64or2cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfeoj2mipn2oln61pj2cljchjm8obkm5im3cbie1om8p1gs6ob6p9jetjb9o9ge3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9ddhcur64phh62pm9ptgmlin49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z32giktq0ktn3vh8hd8p9aav4c6rntf8nbmmrjjo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9g64or2cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5kl7ejh0gmf4tli754i10dnoj1pcu5fb9uaf7ho_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9g64or2cjh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zpq05j5ngi2sa699up5gghhg21dcg2pcgmc7hjsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9g64or2cjh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. | |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62442%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eXqGuWVdNZ8duQ1s8z5HOg&sysid=1)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

---

| **LOS ANGELES, Calif.** \-- As inflation grips the U.S. many Americans are feeling the pinch.

**Prices of numerous consumer goods have exploded** in just a few weeks. Gasoline is up 56 percent. Beef is up 2.3 percent in just one month. And used car prices are up 30 percent.

**“When serious inflation hits, it hits everyone,”** says Ben Stein.

While you might be able to avoid buying a used car, it’s difficult to avoid buying _gas or electricity_ for your car.

Many Americans are now wondering, _“Just how bad is it?”_

_It’s bad. Really bad._

**Overall inflation is up 5 percent in a year** — the largest increase since 2008 — and the _fastest rate_ of increase since 1982.

If your income hasn’t increased at least 5 percent in the last 12 months, then your money just doesn’t go as far today as it did last year. In other words, **you’re going backwards**. _You’re losing purchasing power._

Wolf Richter (a noted wall street investor) argues that inflation is actually higher than reported. Worse, this lost purchasing power is _**NOT**_ coming back. Richter writes:
---
| “The actual loss of purchasing power of the consumer dollar
is **far worse** than even these very ugly inflation data [...]
And this loss of purchasing power is _permanent_.”
---
| **Unfortunately, inflation will continue for at least the next 2 years unless something unheard of happens.** Biden’s trillions in stimulus money continues to flood the economy, making inflation worse. And the Fed doesn’t plan to raise interest rates until 2023 at the earliest.

**Between now and then, inflation will continue to run HOT** — possibly even _hotter_ than right now. Which means higher prices at the pump, the grocery store, the dealership — anywhere you normally buy goods and services.

**Fortunately, Ben Stein has some suggestions to protect you** from Biden’s runaway inflation. He explains it all in his **NEW report called “Inflation, Debt & Disaster”.**

This report is 100% FREE, and you can [**download it in seconds right here**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znqvh4t84m26uivhno6kq0hur28q40cpk653b64g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9g6ep34chh2bs).

**This no-nonsense report to protecting your wealth in retirement** will teach you how to avoid the destructive power of inflation — and possibly even benefit from it.

**Ben Stein knows what he’s talking about.** He’s lived through multiple inflationary periods and wrote extensively about them for the last 45 years. He studied economics at Columbia and Yale, and taught economics at 3 major universities and has written 5 best selling books and hundreds of articles in Barrons, Walls Street Journal, and The American Spectator about inflation.

So don’t wait, **get Ben Stein’s FREE REPORT** to protect your wealth from runaway inflation...

Help me keep the pressure on him over the next two weeks as we prepare for election day.
Let's Go Win!
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

Dear Friend,
My Republican primary opponent is at it again.
After months of lying about my position on funding for cities and towns, now he's trying to convince you that I'm going to use taxpayer dollars to support my race for Governor.
You know me, and you know you can trust me. And, by now, you should also know that as a consistent advocate for taxpayers and their rights, taking taxpayer money to run for Governor is the last thing I'd ever consider doing.
I've had enough of the misrepresentations. And since I know you can't rely on the media to tell you the whole story, I want you to know the truth straight from me:

* FACT: Both Leah Allen and I have pledged that we will not take one single penny of public funding for either of our campaigns in this race. Not one penny.

* FACT: I have been fighting for the rights of taxpayers in our state for more than a decade. As I campaign for Governor, I'm out there every day advocating for taxpayer relief, in particular a temporary suspension of the state gas tax.

* FACT: I support robust Local Aid for our cities and towns. Local Aid takes pressure off local property taxes and funds essential services and schools. I always have, and I always will support our cities and towns.

My campaign agreed to a voluntary spending limit for the election. Meanwhile, my opponents are lining up to spend $7.5 million in the GOP Primary, just to defeat Leah Allen and me, and our pro-taxpayer, pro-freedom message for the people of Massachusetts.
It didn't work at the MassGOP Convention, and it's not going to work at the MassGOP Primary either.
Chris Doughty needs to learn an important lesson: you can't lie or buy your way into the Governor's Office. That office belongs to the people and you have to earn the job.
That's what I'm here to do.
You can count on me.
Sincerely,

name: Donna Shalala
subject: Jared Moskowitz saved lives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

From my time as Secretary of Health and Human Services, I know the importance of having competent and trustworthy people in charge during times of crisis.

Put simply, Jared Moskowitz saved lives as he led our state through the COVID-19 pandemic. We are all extremely fortunate that he was in charge of the Division of Emergency Management. That’s why
I’m proud to support his campaign for Congress.

During the first 18 months of the pandemic, he quickly established testing sites, continuously distributed personal protective equipment to frontline workers, and helped distribute critical information to our residents.

Jared’s critical work during the first 18 months of the pandemic prevented far worse outcomes in the State of Florida and helped us effectively manage the worst of the pandemic.

And under Jared’s direction, vaccine distribution was greatly accelerated, saving the lives of our most vulnerable and reducing infection risks for everyone in Florida.

I’m thankful for Jared’s work, I’m proud to support his campaign, and I’m confident in his ability to advance Democratic causes in Congress.

I’ve served our country and our community for decades, and I know that we’re in a pivotal moment right now. Jared Moskowitz is ready to lead us in Washington, and for that reason, I’m proud to endorse
him.

Warmly,

Donna Shalala

Fmr. Secretary of Health and Human Services
Fmr. Congresswoman

body:
if you mess with our children, we will see you in court!

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she's a "boy" and hid it from her mother...

So, we're dragging the teachers and school into court to make them pay for their disgusting actions and stop this from happening to other children.

[**But to win this critical case I need your help today. That is why I'm asking you to join me by donating to make sure these radical teachers can't brainwash any more children.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3sbdmugma17m07vp463jfj5ajr321mahtpm9gm8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9i61o72c1h2bs)

In case you missed the details of our case when I announced it with Laura Ingraham on her great **Fox News** show **The Ingraham Angle** let me recap it for you.

One day Jessica Konen, a mother of a young 12-year-old girl in middle school was called in and told by the school that her daughter was now a "boy."

What she found out was that over the past several months teachers indoctrinated her sixth-grade daughter into believing she was transgender and bisexual.

Her daughter didn't even know what those two words meant until these sick activist teachers infected her daughter with their twisted beliefs...

The teachers recruited Jessica's daughter to join their "Equality Club" where she was told she may be transgender and bisexual.

The teachers then helped her to create a totally new identity with new names, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom.

They even created a "Gender Support Plan" for her and instructed the faculty to use her new male name and pronouns -- ALL without her mother's knowledge.

And worse than that -- **these radical teachers told Jessica's daughter NOT to tell her mom because she couldn't be "trusted."**

The actions of these teachers and the school are sickening...

They intentionally hid their radical indoctrination from Jessica -- even though the Supreme Court has consistently ruled that parents have the right to control their children's education.

Left-wing activist teachers, administrators and schools are out-of-control...

It's disgusting. It's awful. And we have to stop them.

That's why I'm asking for your help today.

[**Will you join me to make these Left-wing activist teachers and the school pay for their illegal actions?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3qrkctqm73ne80m6mcqmn9vtnmb807l0gne95i8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9i61o72c1h2bs)

You see, we are suing the school AND the teachers for their illegal actions...

Because the only way we're going to stop these activist teachers and administrators is to drag them into court.

The fact is that we have no idea how many other children this is happening to across the country -- Jessica's daughter is just one example.

We know the California Department of Education and the teachers' associations train schools and teachers to keep secrets from parents...

Who knows how many other young children are being poisoned?

Left-wing radicals are using our classrooms to brainwash our children and grandchildren with their sick-and-twisted views.

And we have an opportunity to stop it.

This lawsuit puts every single activist teacher, administrator and school on notice -- if you mess with our children, **we will see you in court!**

They should be teaching our children math, reading and history -- not pushing them to become transgender or bisexual.

But, to stop this from happening -- we need to win this case...

That's why I'm asking for your help immediately today.

[**Will you please step up and make a generous donation to help us drag these radical activists to court?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zm3ur49pi3opp9c4e50a61f11m0eiu10iocspfqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9i61o72c1h2bs)

And please know here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits -- we **WIN** them!!

My name is Harmeet Dhillon and you may recognize me from my numerous appearances on **Newsmax** and **Fox News** with **Laura Ingraham** , **Tucker Carlson** , **Shannon Bream** and **Fox and Friends.**

I've been on a lot talking about our numerous legal battles and victories against the radical Left.

We've already won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court.

We're also taking the fight to big tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives...

But this case to stop activist teachers from corrupting and hurting our children and grandchildren is so important -- it's one we cannot afford to lose.

[**That's why, I'm asking if you can give today -- $35, $50, $100, $250 or more. I will use it to protect our children and grandchildren from the radical Left.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5g2udtbuqmbfuduk45bul7re4rcaogcensudb18_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9i61o72c1h2bs)

So, the next time a radical teacher wants to poison another child with their sick beliefs they'll know that we're watching and are ready to drag them into court...

That is the only way we're going to stop them -- they have to fear the consequences of their actions!

With your help, we'll hold these teachers accountable for brainwashing and grooming their young students- and we'll put all radical leftist teachers on notice that they won't get away with their plot to indoctrinate our kids and erase our parental rights.

Thank you in advance for your support.

**God Bless,**

**Harmeet K. Dhillon**
Founder & CEO, The Center for American Liberty

P.S. Radical activist teachers in California tricked a 12-year-old girl into believing she was transgender and bisexual.

They helped her change into a "boy" with a new identity a new name and new pronouns **\-- and told her to hide it from her mother.**

Now we're dragging these activist teachers and the school into court to pay for their abuse of her young daughter, and I need your help to win.

[**That's why I'm asking you to give an emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100, $250 to stop these radical liberals from poisoning our children.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znve4h55unnq3ttd87uvd3a1evgg4aq2er61fp80_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9i61o72c1h2bs)

We must win this case and put every single Left-wing teacher and school on notice -- if you infect our children with your radical values we will drag you into court too!

RINO Rich continues refusal to return or answer questions on tens of thousands of liberal special interest dollars
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SMR0uJUNBVDEq6jTte4uYns6wcVLXHvXiyI2w2Cg3xFOCqhYRFyztlASTRKOT1NkFRAS4AbV5Sshdk1qrNWT311htRVE3eBdRCzfo2Kt3HfHksUxVcNPxkeHHFvlx085AOB351BCL9U=&c=-lAAwNiqr6AGgN73UHkycyvl4riK3fOp7sOKPzOvu7MeS2T884xWmg==&ch=FzUyB13sPdxl3q9lL62YSbEnmdtPKM_FaeT5vkRZGb57pzk2hJ8bPA==)

| For immediate release June 14th, 2022 RINO Rich continues refusal to return or answer questions on tens of thousands of liberal special interest dollars
Weeks into the runoff, Rich McCormick has refused to return tens of thousands of dollars from liberal special interests that support abortion on demand, anti-gun policies and allowing biological males to compete in girls sports or to answer questions on if these destructive positions are consistent with his. "RINO Rich McCormick has shown us who he really is - a wannabe politician who'll say whatever the person in front of him wants to hear to collect votes and campaign dollars," said John Mason Long, Jake's campaign manager. "Rich hasn't given back tens of thousands of dollars from liberal special interests pushing an agenda that 6th District voters vehemently oppose, and he has refused over and over to tell voters what he told them and what he told the centrist Mainstreet Republican Partnership to get its endorsement. It's obvious that RINO Rich tells Washington special interests one thing and then comes to Georgia and tells us something different. We have no shortage of those kinds of spineless politicians in Congress already." "As 6th District voters begin to early vote, they have a stark choice in this election: an establishment politician that is bought out and compromised by liberal special interest groups, and that will vote with the Democrats, or a bold and unafraid, Trump-endorsed Constitutional Warrior who will fight for our principles. For 6th District voters who want a return to the America First agenda that strengthened our country, Jake Evans is the only choice."

| | Friend, The FBI just showed up. You read that right. _**The FBI sent people to my home to arrest me. **_ This is face of tyranny and government overreach. Anyone who has followed our campaign knows I am prepared to give my life fighting against this exact oppression. But let me back up. My name is Ryan Kelley. You've probably never heard of me, or at least hadn't heard of me before today when my name and picture was splashed across every news outlet in the country. Thats ok. The media and the establishment swamp have tried to pretend I don't exist, but I am now leading in the polls to be the Republican nominee for Governor in Michigan. **That's right. Governor. In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. I have no intention of letting up now. ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpij21hb2p06fgolers26oa0gudr75cp7npn4b18_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h68pb6c3h2bs) That they're trying to throw me in prison shows they're scared. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. Here’s the truth: we’re $35,788 away from closing our budget. No exaggeration, no hyperbole, once we raise it, we’re done asking for money, and then we all can spend every waking minute of the day talking to voters. So what’s in the budget? Well I’ve previously explained our polling: I lead by 4% in the initial head to head, but after voters hear that I’m their trusted weatherman and a scientist, **then my lead nearly doubles to 7%**. body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv3r758mkl87dsku40jahvp243ae7blpgagj1i30_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h64ob4c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6p1impprbd70eopn4phmmuon1o73mjjjaddgedo67dj2e9rb9obmcpq74s32e3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9ddhcupb4phlcipm0ptgmlin49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf0kgf8giomsdaoeffukpin45bnic09k8qc99kj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h64ob4c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z79to0neb9csgfe7d921v4emekpajcstb8qk5t9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h64ob4c1h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrd6622hfmfovt3qsecf0emhpo9rapf6973i86rg_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h64ob4c1h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, JUNE 14
NATIONAL REVIEW HIGHLIGHTS GREATER GEORGIA EFFORTS, HISTORIC CONSERVATIVE RE-ENGAGEMENT
(ATLANTA) - Today, National Review published an [article](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010oW-8U27pUi-Dd5r-DgJ_KkWykk5efPMUSwivPJX9w_eFTHkXDD8uoIMShkoZHq_dc3n5QnCeXjgDKlRSMKc35zpUP0xl0JaHYLfSGAaRmyVAuyDbnU7iiF814UoHMrKp6VyK-d3gTNLFQs7R0-7umu12i549br7435tSeKs_qOLpuB21aMqi0SdKxoTSVRSj2zCtgfr6bo=&c=Pg6o8OPaI9YB0zOXWfopFjyWyf1ihy7PWF9iSby0VRYtAJYvh-m6qw==&ch=K8aT_Q9GONZiUM-pz5HdJ8IjqYBypD_5_fj3F7xA1ZfUsGu90vEqOA==) highlighting the efforts of Greater Georgia, and the tremendous re-engagement of conservatives in the May 24th primary. As detailed in the piece, overall turnout in the primary increased by 66% over the last midterm primary, and conservative participation increased an incredible 98% - due largely to the state's new election integrity laws, and Greater Georgia's data-driven efforts to mobilize "disenfranchised" voters who were disillusioned by the 2020 election.
View excerpts from the story below, or read the full piece [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010oW-8U27pUi-Dd5r-DgJ_KkWykk5efPMUSwivPJX9w_eFTHkXDD8uoIMShkoZHq_dc3n5QnCeXjgDKlRSMKc35zpUP0xl0JaHYLfSGAaRmyVAuyDbnU7iiF814UoHMrKp6VyK-d3gTNLFQs7R0-7umu12i549br7435tSeKs_qOLpuB21aMqi0SdKxoTSVRSj2zCtgfr6bo=&c=Pg6o8OPaI9YB0zOXWfopFjyWyf1ihy7PWF9iSby0VRYtAJYvh-m6qw==&ch=K8aT_Q9GONZiUM-pz5HdJ8IjqYBypD_5_fj3F7xA1ZfUsGu90vEqOA==).
Kelly Loeffler could have spent the last 15 months licking nasty wounds, and who could have blamed her? Her painful U.S. Senate run-off special-election loss to hard-core leftist Democrat Raphael Warnock -- paired on the same night with incumbent Republican Senator David Perdue's run-off defeat to progressive Jon Ossoff -- handed control of Congress to the Democrats, hearkening to the Charlie Daniels Band's tune that the devil may indeed have come down to Georgia. But maybe not to stay.
Loeffler has dedicated the intervening, pouting-free year to building and orchestrating something politically consequential, evident in the results of Georgia's recent primaries. Launching Greater Georgia last year, Loeffler and her team set about raising funds (a lot her own money) and developing a winning strategy to activate the enormous number of conservative voters -- a bloc that clearly had the potential to have flipped the 2021 special-elections' outcomes -- who had become part of that ugly category: the "disenfranchised."
Specifically, on January 5, 2021, they proved to be non-voters. Last month, they proved reengaged. Why the turnaround?
...
If we leave aside the impact and value of Donald Trump's political influence, we can see that primary Election Day in Georgia proved several things. One is that the Georgia election-reform law accomplished what its supporters pledged -- in the face of relentless, high-level, hyperbolic attacks: that it would enhance voting. It did: Turnout was historic. Nearly 1.93 million Georgians voted in the 2022 primary, compared with 1.16 million in 2018. Do the math: That's a massive, two-thirds increase, and a kiboshing of the Left's nasty allegations about the law's intended voter suppression. If there ever was a guy named Jim Crow, he was spinning in his grave on May 24, as confidence in election integrity clearly won the day.
As for party breakdown in the primaries, over 1.2 million Georgians cast Republican ballots, with Democrats registering 724,244 -- that was an increase for the GOP of 89 percent from 2018, far outpacing the 30 percent gain experienced by Democrats. The timetable has moved up: Many voters showed they were not waiting for the midterms to possibly reengage. The sweet-and-clear data shows that the road has led back to the ballot box.
Accessing information from absentee- and early-voting turnout, Greater Georgia has run the numbers: Pre-Election Day voting was up 166 percent over 2018, sparked in part by 85,000 Republican-ballot voters who had not participated in any of the state's previous four primaries. Nearly 22,000 disenfranchised conservatives were also among the early voters. And compared with 2018, GOP voters were up 375 percent among Asians, 281 percent among Blacks, and nearly 400 per cent among Hispanics.
Another thing the primary results proved was the GOP voter renaissance is the result of sweat and smarts. If something's to blame for the motivation -- besides the endless calamities of the Biden presidency, confidence in election integrity sparked by the reform law, and strong primary candidates, such as incumbent Governor Brian Kemp -- it's Greater Georgia. Founded by Loeffler, who showed herself as a determined and engaged chairwoman, the organization embarked on an ambitious, yearlong effort to contact and motivate over 1 million "unregistered, disengaged, and disenfranchised conservatives" via nearly 2 million voter contacts -- calls, texts, community events, ads, roundtables, aggressive voter-registration drives, you name it. Going toe to toe with the Democratic ground-game tactics, which strike fear in the hearts of many a Republican operative, Greater Georgia's sustained mobilization and education efforts and strategy proved consequential, even decisive. The Peach State's disaffected conservatives seem a lot less disenfranchised.
...
And if one may conclude an important lesson to be had from the primary's outcomes and data, it's this: The hard work performed by Georgia conservatives, coupled with real election-integrity reform that actually protects and expands voting, show that the province of early voting -- rightly a bugaboo of many who find it a permissive opportunity for political shenanigans, and when the value of a vote gets discounted -- is no longer the exclusive plaything and monopoly of the Left.

clean_body: | | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, JUNE 14 NATIONAL REVIEW HIGHLIGHTS GREATER GEORGIA EFFORTS, HISTORIC CONSERVATIVE RE-ENGAGEMENT (ATLANTA) - Today, National Review published an == highlighting the efforts of Greater Georgia, and the tremendous re-engagement of conservatives in the May 24th primary. As detailed in the piece, overall turnout in the primary increased by 66% over the last midterm primary, and conservative participation increased an incredible 98% - due largely to the state's new election integrity laws, and Greater Georgia's data-driven efforts to mobilize "disenfranchised" voters who were disillusioned by the 2020 election. View excerpts from the story below, or read the full piece ==. Kelly Loeffler could have spent the last 15 months licking nasty wounds, and who could have blamed her? Her painful U.S. Senate run-off special-election loss to hard-core leftist Democrat Raphael Warnock -- paired on the same night with incumbent Republican Senator David Perdue's run-off defeat to progressive Jon Ossoff -- handed control of Congress to the Democrats, hearkening to the Charlie Daniels Band's tune that the devil may indeed have come down to Georgia. But maybe not to stay. Loeffler has dedicated the intervening, pouting-free year to building and orchestrating something politically consequential, evident in the results of Georgia's recent primaries. Launching Greater Georgia last year, Loeffler and her team set about raising funds (a lot her own money) and developing a winning strategy to activate the enormous number of conservative voters -- a bloc that clearly had the potential to have flipped the 2021 special-elections' outcomes -- who had become part of that ugly category: the "disenfranchised." Specifically, on January 5, 2021, they proved to be non-voters. Last month, they proved reengaged. Why the turnaround? ... If we leave aside the impact and value of Donald Trump's political influence, we can see that primary Election Day in Georgia proved several things. One is that the Georgia election-reform law accomplished what its supporters pledged -- in the face of relentless, high-level, hyperbolic attacks: that it would enhance voting. It did: Turnout was historic. Nearly 1.93 million Georgians voted in the 2022 primary, compared with 1.16 million in 2018. Do the math: That's a massive, two-thirds increase, and a kiboshing of the Left's nasty allegations about the law's intended voter suppression. If there ever was a guy named Jim Crow, he was spinning in his grave on May 24, as confidence in election integrity clearly won the day. As for party breakdown in the primaries, over 1.2 million Georgians cast Republican ballots, with Democrats registering 724,244 -- that was an increase for the GOP of 89 percent from 2018, far outpacing the 30 percent gain experienced by Democrats. The timetable has moved up: Many voters showed they were not waiting for the midterms to possibly reengage. The sweet-and-clear data shows that the road has led back to the ballot box. Accessing information from absentee- and early-voting turnout, Greater Georgia has run the numbers: Pre-Election Day voting was up 166 percent over 2018, sparked in part by 85,000 Republican-ballot voters who had not participated in any of the state's previous four primaries. Nearly 22,000 disenfranchised conservatives were also among the early voters. And compared with 2018, GOP voters were up 375 percent among Asians, 281 percent among Blacks, and nearly 400 per cent among Hispanics. Another thing the primary results proved was the GOP voter renaissance is the result of sweat and smarts. If something's to blame for the motivation -- besides the endless calamities of the Biden presidency, confidence in election integrity sparked by the reform law, and strong primary candidates, such as incumbent Governor Brian Kemp -- it's Greater Georgia. Founded by Loeffler, who showed herself as a determined and engaged chairwoman, the organization embarked on an ambitious, yearlong effort to contact and motivate over 1 million "unregistered, disengaged, and disenfranchised conservatives" via nearly 2 million voter contacts -- calls, texts, community events, ads, roundtables, aggressive voter-registration drives, you name it. Going toe to toe with the Democratic ground-game tactics, which strike fear in the hearts of many a Republican operative, Greater Georgia's sustained mobilization and education efforts and strategy proved consequential, even decisive. The Peach State's disaffected conservatives seem a lot less disenfranchised. ... And if one may conclude an important lesson to be had from the primary's outcomes and data, it's this: The hard work performed by Georgia conservatives, coupled with real election-integrity reform that actually protects and expands voting, show that the province of early voting -- rightly a bugaboo of many who find it a permissive opportunity for political shenanigans, and when the value of a vote gets discounted -- is no longer the exclusive plaything and monopoly of the Left. | ### Media Contact: mailto:press@greatergeorgia.com | | | | Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc. But during my time in education, I worked with incredible people from all over and saw America for what it was — its strengths, weaknesses, where we could do better, what our neighbors needed help with. So I knew — with the right team — we could do some good in the Senate, fighting for the state we loved and the country that welcomed my and many others’ immigrant families. And thanks to folks like you, we’ve been here ever since working to expand opportunity for all. But now we’re up for re-election and Mitch McConnell has already made me a top target. All Republicans have to do is flip one seat to retake the Senate majority, and it’s clear he has his sights set on Colorado. Anyone who has followed our campaign knows I am prepared to give my life fighting against this exact oppression. But let me back up. My name is Ryan Kelley. You've probably never heard of me, or at least hadn't heard of me before today when my name and picture was splashed across every news outlet in the country. Thats ok. The media and the establishment swamp have tried to pretend I don't exist, but I am now leading in the polls to be the Republican nominee for Governor in Michigan. **That's right. Governor. In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. I have no intention of letting up now. ](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z3a8alnvlqn1mbt28vr4rjh293mifatjqdin5g1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h6eo76cph2bs) That they're trying to throw me in prison shows they're scared. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. The question is: _What will you do next?_ Will you delete this email and go back to your day waiting around for them to take away your next freedom? Maybe your second and first amendment rights next? Or will you [click the link, make a donation, and be part of the true grassroots movement that is building here](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7v5toh966ma3kdpt8nfrc1pq75cdasqaglrn3r8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9h6eo76cph2bs)? I've made it clear where I stand. I will not back down. I will not stop defending OUR rights. Yours and mine. I need you to commit, right now. Click the link, make as generous a donation as you can. **They want us silent. They want us on our knees.** Stand up. Stand with me. Get involved right now, while there is still time.

name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: 10 Facts About the U.S. Flag
body:
10 Facts About the U.S. FlagBernard Cigrand, a small-town Wisconsin teacher, originated the idea for an annual flag day, to be celebrated across the country every June 14, in 1885.It is widely believe
|
---
| | | | |
---
## 10 Facts About the U.S. Flag

1. Bernard Cigrand, a small-town Wisconsin teacher, originated the idea for an annual flag day, to be celebrated across the country every June 14, in 1885.
2. It is widely believed that [_Betsy Rosssomeone ,_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/p7bSwOi9wLxynRFsY9e5KQ) who assisted the [_Revolutionary War_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/gNHXukGawWZftDJ5L7sopQ) effort by repairing uniforms and sewing tents made the first American flag. However, there is no historical evidence that she contributed to Old Glory’s creation. It was not until her grandson, William Canby, held an 1870 press conference to recount the story that the American public learned of her possible role. It has since been confirmed that Francis Hopkinson, a delegate from New Jersey who signed the Declaration of Independence, designed the American flag.
3. The lyrics of “The Star-Spangled Banner,” America’s national anthem since 1931, are taken from a patriotic poem written by [_Francis Scott Key_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/sxxLnTQ7tRvdUma-8DQYPQ) after he witnessed the Battle of Fort McHenry during the [_War of 1812_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/ZJFLRXpLq4vuZHzOkpo0iQ).
4. In the 1950s, when it seemed certain that [_Alaska would be admitted to the Union_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/KzxhCtbVvuSLHdL1oTxsJg) , designers began retooling the American flag to add a 49th star to the existing 48. Meanwhile, a 17-year-old Ohio student named Bob Heft borrowed his mother’s sewing machine, disassembled his family’s 48-star flag and stitched on 50 stars in a proportional pattern. He handed in his creation to his history teacher for a class project, explaining that he expected Hawaii would soon achieve statehood as well. Heft also sent the flag to his congressman, Walter Moeller, who presented it to [_President Eisenhower_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/woPrjdOmxxiM_fG-m1Wu0Q) after both new states joined the Union. Eisenhower selected Heft’s design, and on July 4, 1960, the president and the high school students stood together as the 50-star flag was raised for the first time. Heft’s teacher promptly changed his grade from a B- to an A.
5. Unlike setting an intact flag on fire, flying one upside-down is not always intended as an act of protest. According to the Flag Code, it can also be an official distress signal.
6. The Flag Code stipulates that the Stars and Stripes should not be used as apparel, bedding or drapery.
7. The practice of draping coffins in the American flag is not reserved for military veterans and government officials. On the contrary, any burial may incorporate this tradition.
8. Etiquette calls for American flags to be illuminated by sunlight or another light source while on display.
9. During the [_Vietnam War_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/_ZgiJI4jf_jFHNQPhlRcUA) era, some demonstrators burned American flags as an act of protest. The Flag Protection Act of 1968 was enacted in response, making it illegal to burn or otherwise deface the Stars and Stripes. In two landmark decisions 20 years later, the Supreme Court ruled that the government couldn’t curb individuals’ [_First Amendment_](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/PUtI5OaIbbvQ_-b2SD2C2Q) rights by prohibiting desecration of the U.S. flag. Respectful burning of damaged flags according to established protocol has always been acceptable.
10. When flags are taken down from their poles, care must be taken to keep them from touching the ground. In fact, the American flag should always be kept aloft, meaning that rugs and carpets featuring the Stars and Stripes are barred by the Flag Code.

body:
What we want is real, meaningful action to prevent gun violence and keep our kids and our communities safe – not guns in schools.

Team,

After signing a bill yesterday putting guns into our schools – around our kids – with minimal training requirements, Mike DeWine was asked if he thought this was what Ohioans had in mind when the people of Dayton called on him to take sensible action in the wake of the devastating shooting that rocked our community and killed nine of our neighbors and loved ones.

His response? **“I don’t know.”**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46517324/350596396/-704846304?refcode=nw_email_220614_1_t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2JhYjM5OC0wZWVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sCuAU3WW06uEXmvYUlip2kb16Nygr3UlNIsqbyh1m94=)**
**[We need a governor who will take the action Ohioans want to end gun violence – not cater to the gun lobby – and that’s my commitment. Will you pitch in $5 to make that a reality?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46517325/350596397/-704846304?refcode=nw_email_220614_1_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2JhYjM5OC0wZWVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sCuAU3WW06uEXmvYUlip2kb16Nygr3UlNIsqbyh1m94=)**

Mike DeWine promised us _nearly three years ago_ that he would take action to prevent gun violence.

We asked him to “do something” – we called for common sense measures like universal background checks, which are supported by an overwhelming majority of Ohioans.

DeWine did the opposite. He turned around and caved to the gun lobby, signing multiple bills just this spring that make our communities less safe. And he even admitted that he “doesn’t know” if that’s what Ohioans want – _but he signed it anyway. _

**[What we want is real, meaningful action to prevent gun violence and keep our kids and our communities safe – not guns in schools. If you agree, chip in to my campaign and help me defeat Mike DeWine.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46517326/350596398/-704846304?refcode=nw_email_220614_1_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2JhYjM5OC0wZWVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sCuAU3WW06uEXmvYUlip2kb16Nygr3UlNIsqbyh1m94=)**
Onward,

Nan

Mark is my best friend, my partner, and my rock.
#

Mark is my best friend, my partner, and my rock. I feel so lucky to have him by my side every day.
He has helped me through my darkest moments and he always fights for what is right.
At war, he flew in combat, and at peace he joined NASA and commanded the space shuttle twice.
Mark never planned to be a Senator, but he knows when it’s time to serve. He’s served his family, our country, and now the great state of Arizona.

name: Matthew Diemer
subject: Max Miller's Role on January 6th
body:
Max Miller was subpoenaed by congress for his possible role in the attack on January 6. We can’t let an election denier represent us in congress. | |
---
Peter, As Congress holds its investigation into the circumstances and players of the January 6th riot, I think many legislators and pundits are missing the big picture. ** ** January 6th was the result of months of built up aggression at the outcome of the presidential election. A violent mob attacking the Capitol to overturn the lawful outcome of an election is horrible. It's even more worrying that so many elected officials either downplayed the attack, or even helped it happen. ** ** We must remember that there is a serious risk that the lawlessness and lack of respect for democracy we saw on January 6th will repeat itself. Candidates who refuse to respect the legitimate results of our elections should be kept as far away from Congress as possible. Max Miller has helped spread election lies for Donald Trump, and was subpoenaed by the January 6th Committee for his role in the events that led to the attempted insurrection. **We can 't let an election denier represent us in congress.** ** **

We can’t let an election denier represent us in congress. | | Peter, As Congress holds its investigation into the circumstances and players of the January 6th riot, I think many legislators and pundits are missing the big picture. It's even more worrying that so many elected officials either downplayed the attack, or even helped it happen. We must remember that there is a serious risk that the lawlessness and lack of respect for democracy we saw on January 6th will repeat itself. | | Dear Peter, The November general election is less than five months away and what happens will have a huge impact on the future of our state. Voters will choose a new governor and who they elect will determine how (and _if_) our state continues to address important issues including climate change. This year is the first time that Oregon has had an open governor’s race in over 20 years, making this the most critical race for governor in a generation. OLCV endorsed former House Speaker Tina Kotek in the primary and she won! But Tina faces a tough race in the general – going up against a wealthy timber heiress who is raking in huge donations from Big Oil and other corporate polluters, and a Republican who helped lead the 2020 walkouts to stop landmark climate legislation from passing. [**The importance of this year’s governor’s race can’t be overstated. Help us make sure that our next governor will be a climate champion and continue to move our state forward, not backward, by making a contribution to the OLCV PAC today.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46518282/350600346/913998683?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhhZGFhMDg3LTEzZWMtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=PrmyjkGSz9-Pg1T-OenoklFwaEcdFI-jb9S4VrYnpn0=&emci=fcefa06c-10ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=8adaa087-13ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) As House Speaker, Tina was a climate champion and she was behind all of the major climate wins of the past seven years. In 2015 she was named OLCV’s Defender of the Year, she prevented rollbacks to Clean Fuels in 2017, and stood up for Clean Energy Jobs in 2019 and 2020. She is a proven leader who will ensure that our state continues to make progress toward a just transition to a clean energy future. This decade is critical for the future of our state and our planet. We have no time to waste and no time to go backward. Will you help ensure that our state is led by a climate and environmental champion by supporting our work today? We can’t do it without you. Sincerely,
Doug Moore

| | Friend, Senator Tom Cotton here, reaching out today to tell you why I’m supporting Jesse Reising for Illinois’ 13th District — and humbly asking you to join me. Jesse is a sixth-generation son of Central Illinois, a former federal prosecutor, and a tough conservative. He was recruited to play college football and, having gone through Marine Corps Officer Candidates’ School, was preparing to become a Marine Officer and ship to Afghanistan. But in Jesse’s last college football game, he endured a serious injury that severed two nerves in his neck and left him partially paralyzed. **But Jesse didn’t give up.** He recovered, went to Afghanistan as a civilian contractor, and co-founded a veterans’ service group called the Warrior Scholar Project. That group has helped thousands of returning veterans transition from the military to college. **Jesse’s life of service and commitment makes him the perfect candidate to win in November. I need him in Congress with me to restore the rule of law and stop Joe Biden’s runaway inflation.** I couldn’t be prouder to support Jesse Reising for Congress, but he can’t win without _your_ help, too. **Please chip in whatever you can, right now, or sign up to volunteer to help Jesse win this critical election.**

Jesse Reising comes from a long line of Central Illinoisans, with his ancestors arriving by horseback among the first 300 settlers in Decatur in the 1830s. He was recruited from the heartland public school system to attend and play football at Yale University. While Jesse was a starting linebacker for Yale and a Marine Corps Officer Candidate, he suffered a massive neck injury during a football game. It left him partially paralyzed and ended his plans to join the Marine Corps. Jesse set out to do three things to replace his Marine Corps Service: (1) go to Afghanistan to support the United States military’s efforts as a civilian; (2) co-found the Warrior-Scholar Project to serve those serving in the military; and (3) serve his country as a federal prosecutor. After graduating from Yale, Jesse achieved all 3 of his goals. As a federal prosecutor, Jesse prosecuted white-collar criminals and foreign business executives who were manipulating American economic markets. The cases Jesse prosecuted resulted in the recovery of over $100 million for the American taxpayer. Now Jesse is running for Congress so he can continue to protect taxpayers, strengthen the economy, stand by law enforcement, empower veterans to succeed, and protect the agriculture industry that is vital to Illinois.

Anyone who has followed our campaign knows I am prepared to give my life fighting against this exact oppression. But let me back up. My name is Ryan Kelley. You've probably never heard of me, or at least hadn't heard of me before today when my name and picture was splashed across every news outlet in the country. Thats ok. The media and the establishment swamp have tried to pretend I don't exist, but I am now leading in the polls to be the Republican nominee for Governor in Michigan. **That's right. Governor. In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. I have no intention of letting up now. ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5h1p1241pq24hdqprnbvvnqfq36qh7bugg4aoq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9j6coj6clh2bs) That they're trying to throw me in prison shows they're scared. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. clean_body: This is about more than winning. | | | Dear Team, On Friday, NPR’s news station in Chicago, WBEZ,** covered the Chicago congressional race where, in their words, things are “heating up,” IL-7. I’m glad to see the , , and now NPR, all paying attention to the calls for change on the ground in IL-7, but for me the most exciting thing was hearing the recognition of the fundamental truth we know about progressives running for office: When young progressive community members run for office they “win seats in Congress, and then when they get there they make a difference.” -** This race isn’t about winning an election, it is about transforming the fundamental reality for thousands of people living across the 7th Congressional District. Poverty, lack of healthcare, lack of childcare, gun violence, and poor access to education don’t have to be a daily reality. Further in the same segment, the panelists say exactly what needs to be said, “One of the arguments you hear against Danny Davis is, he’s been there for 25 years, what has he really accomplished?” That should not be a question it is even possible to ask. Publicly reporting our campaign fundraising numbers for the upcoming FEC
deadline is a big enough deal on its own, but this time around, there are
even more factors at play that add to the impact this filing has. Here are
a few of the major things I’m taking into consideration:

* I’m running in a brand new district. For the first time ever, I’ll be
on the general ballot for California’s 30th congressional district.
Right-wing Fox News talking heads will see this as an opportunity to
smear my name to voters who may have never seen me on a ballot until
now. Having a weak FEC report would just give them more fodder to
peddle lies over the airwaves.
* Republicans have made their top priorities clear. They’re attacking
reproductive rights, denying any accountability for their actions on
January 6th, and standing in the way of common-sense gun safety
measures. It’s clear that they’ve fully embraced MAGA extremism and
will do anything to gain Trump’s attention.
* This is the final FEC deadline until September, the final sprint of
the election. It’s a midterm year, and having a strong FEC report this
summer will serve as a temperature gauge for what’s to come in
November. Everyone — political pundits, the media, and our opponents
will be looking at our report to see if we have the momentum needed to
defend our majorities and expand upon them.

These are a few of the many reasons why I need your support before our
mid-month deadline tomorrow. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2022_abs_em.pEwDN5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20220614_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1011&akid=358%2E5257348%2E_G08Z6 ]If you can, contribute $10 to help us get

subject: They sent the FBI
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michigan for Ryan D
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r)
---
| | Peter, Do you know what a misdemeanor is? It's commonly defined as a minor wrong doing. If you google it, you get something back like: _A misdemeanor is any "lesser" criminal act in some common law legal systems...Typically misdemeanors are punished with monetary fines or community service._ Do you know how many armed FBI agents usually get sent to arrest someone for a misdemeanor? **Zero. 0. None. Sending the FBI is an absurd way to handle a misdemeanor.** But that's exactly what they did. Biden's DOJ sent the FBI to my house. Armed men handcuffed me in front of my children and took me to jail, so they could charge me with misdemeanor trespassing. Just before sitting down to write you, I was on the radio talking with Steve Bannon. By now you must be asking the same question he did: _**why!?!?**_ Because it's not about justice. It's about politics and intimidation. I went to the Stop the Steal Rally on Jan 6th. I stood up against tyranny and exercised my right to demonstrate in the face of wrongdoing. This is the response. This is your government, your tax dollars, your nation bringing its boot down on the neck of its people. This is the bureaucracy bringing its weight down to try and push those who stand, back to their knees. __This is the way they senselessly scream**COMPLY.**__ It isn't about justice. It's about politics. It's about intimidation.
---
[**JOIN RYAN: STAND UP TO POLITICAL INTIMIDATION**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r)
---
They knew when they sent armed federal agents to my house, it was for a press story. They knew any judge was likely to immediately release me. Which is exactly what happened. **They don't care. They don't care about the cost.** They don't care about right and wrong. They care about the message. [Well, I have a message, too. **I will never kneel. I will never bow to tyranny. I will never give away my rights.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r) This government is not about the machine. It's not about the swamp. This government is meant to serve the people, not suppress them. _The power to stop them is within our hands. It always has been. It is power we must use now. We must win in November. We must win now._ We've given away our liberty in drips and drabs...in exchange for peace of mind or the illusion of security.... We've been giving it away for the promise of safety in return... **But where they said safety, they meant control.** We are at a pivotal moment in our Republic. The yoke of the government has grown heavier than it has ever been, but built slowly enough that many haven't noticed. They simply keep moving. We cannot let another year compound. We must stand up and demand our freedom back. We must stop this backward descent from the very liberty that enabled every triumph in our nation's history. It stops with you. It stops with your help. Any donation, a dollar or a thousand. Whatever you can give: Every penny matters. The donations will allow us to keep up this fight, but just as importantly: Every single person who gives is another voice that won't go silent, another patriot standing up, another brick in the wall we are building to protect our freedom from those who wish to take it. _**I am not a politician. I never intended to run for office. I wanted to run my business. I wanted to raise my family. I wanted to serve God and live my faith.**_ When the government came and told me I could no longer do those things-- When they came and told us all that our church doors would be barred, that our businesses would be shut, that our kids couldn't go to school... That was the day I knew I had to stand up. I am running for Governor because liberty for the People of the United States is not an idea I am willing to watch die without a fight. I am not willing to look back on my life and say... _...when our rights were challenged...__...when our freedom was being eroded...__...when the vision of my children 's future was being darkened and narrowed..._ ... I am not willing to look back and say I did anything less than everything. Everything. From the minute those agents were dispatched, this has been about a message... A message to me: To shut up, to sit down, that my life, my family, my freedom are theirs to threaten. But it's also a message to you. It's a message to every citizen. To every free soul. They're saying don't stand: Don't you dare stand up. Don't support patriots running for office. Don't refuse us. Don't speak up. Don't take off your mask. Don't disobey. Don't. **Their message is simple: Comply.** **My message is also simple: No.**
---
[**JOIN RYAN: STAND UP TO POLITICAL INTIMIDATION**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r)
---
But I cannot stay standing forever alone. I need you. **[I need you to make a donation so that we have the resources needed to fight back.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r)** There will be sleepless nights, there will be days in court, there will be rallies, there will be doors to knock...there will be work. I am not afraid of that. I am not afraid of doing the work...I am afraid of what happens if we don't do it. Please, I am asking you as plainly as I can: **[Click this link and make a donation right now. We need to do the work. We need your help.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584881:6H1fDeoJN:m:1:3317145305:28F6711808EB1EDB7B0F63A150A64AE0:r)**
---

The donations will allow us to keep up this fight, but just as importantly: Every single person who gives is another voice that won't go silent, another patriot standing up, another brick in the wall we are building to protect our freedom from those who wish to take it. I am not a politician. I never intended to run for office. I wanted to run my business. I wanted to raise my family. I wanted to serve God and live my faith. When the government came and told me I could no longer do those things-- When they came and told us all that our church doors would be barred, that our businesses would be shut, that our kids couldn't go to school... That was the day I knew I had to stand up. I am running for Governor because liberty for the People of the United States is not an idea I am willing to watch die without a fight. I am not willing to look back on my life and say... ...when our rights were challenged......when our freedom was being eroded......when the vision of my children 's future was being darkened and narrowed... ... I am not willing to look back and say I did anything less than everything. Everything. From the minute those agents were dispatched, this has been about a message... A message to me: To shut up, to sit down, that my life, my family, my freedom are theirs to threaten. But it's also a message to you. It's a message to every citizen. To every free soul. They're saying don't stand: Don't you dare stand up. Don't support patriots running for office. Don't refuse us. Don't speak up. Don't take off your mask. Don't disobey. Don't. Their message is simple: Comply. My message is also simple: No. But I cannot stay standing forever alone. I need you. There will be sleepless nights, there will be days in court, there will be rallies, there will be doors to knock...there will be work. I am not afraid of that. I am not afraid of doing the work...I am afraid of what happens if we don't do it. Please, I am asking you as plainly as I can: Ryan D.
