Do you know how many armed FBI agents usually get sent to arrest someone for a misdemeanor?| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1c09183b1e5f4eadbeb9656c3afff777&_e=-LmJksAJL26RdTyW3Tf5-JFeOJrUnKmKNqhrNm5ok9LuRkEyOh0Mwe-7-JtzzVzyRg9HncOYkBx7oKJZ1KzlPntZPoFi2qPkmRBzxiyXlJhCbbM-un8iRs1RWHkGbb5_LQf_OLOv647FeyWnipdDRC6lXPHgdYsgkqdZliJUlvzi7l_lbqci9G5CrXhl44qcOBU33KfGILxuk83huwlfz7c4pg9vNJntUyg7x604nyilF_pCqfIabxelq6cuI33jcnJzkDfCeuKX8mye_fYNZm1lMIzBOAL_najuwM-diejKRlwT2O38TI398iPtzolmjzu_2Ek7l7kM1jbKUyZ3ZDOKaPotj5-Z3wrYX-YGq5c3pr8TB_ggh27WFzCOoqO3Il5tq7vqyQxatZI4P8Bgw1nc8CafbI3XD0tQbzcMl35mh2DtaR2U3E29Brpaw5kKRkZLNJWZrSojsk3D-ucOMTOC9Qq1rm3DjC1qXha5c0TgnrwpB032rZzQD3-1fyCg)
---
| | Peter, Do you know what a misdemeanor is? It's commonly defined as a minor wrong doing. If you google it, you get something back like: _A misdemeanor is any "lesser" criminal act in some common law legal systems...Typically misdemeanors are punished with monetary fines or community service._ Do you know how many armed FBI agents usually get sent to arrest someone for a misdemeanor? **Zero. 0. None. Sending the FBI is an absurd way to handle a misdemeanor.** But that's exactly what they did. Biden's DOJ sent the FBI to my house. Armed men handcuffed me in front of my children and took me to jail, so they could charge me with misdemeanor trespassing. Just before sitting down to write you, I was on the radio talking with Steve Bannon. By now you must be asking the same question he did: _**why!?!?**_ Because it's not about justice. It's about politics and intimidation. I went to the Stop the Steal Rally on Jan 6th. I stood up against tyranny and exercised my right to demonstrate in the face of wrongdoing. This is the response. This is your government, your tax dollars, your nation bringing its boot down on the neck of its people. This is the bureaucracy bringing its weight down to try and push those who stand, back to their knees. __This is the way they senselessly scream**COMPLY.**__ It isn't about justice. It's about politics. It's about intimidation.
---
[**JOIN RYAN: STAND UP TO POLITICAL INTIMIDATION**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1c09183b1e5f4eadbeb9656c3afff777&_e=-LmJksAJL26RdTyW3Tf5-JFeOJrUnKmKNqhrNm5ok9LuRkEyOh0Mwe-7-JtzzVzyRg9HncOYkBx7oKJZ1KzlPntZPoFi2qPkmRBzxiyXlJhCbbM-un8iRs1RWHkGbb5_LQf_OLOv647FeyWnipdDRC6lXPHgdYsgkqdZliJUlvzi7l_lbqci9G5CrXhl44qcOBU33KfGILxuk83huwlfz7c4pg9vNJntUyg7x604nyilF_pCqfIabxelq6cuI33jcnJzkDfCeuKX8mye_fYNZm1lMIzBOAL_najuwM-diehnZx2KnBZ6KF5fQZiTi1qWoR5R1HmrRWH1IBtdE_bsrwO4VtGMUkk-Nwe2XhCtzFni02tv4jUV_YqY9HYKeYlBNferfVJjx_6V6VDxyBcP_KdmnjxXL22n-bMcs9e9N-ufVglou2vsB0CPnSBCy2XQRh5UPh7AKaqLoiY7vJEuFILbHRzXw2CK6g4isX7BwoQG6TCFzLFhhxaWrmxjcCSH)
---
They knew when they sent armed federal agents to my house, it was for a press story. They knew any judge was likely to immediately release me. Which is exactly what happened. **They don't care. They don't care about the cost.** They don't care about right and wrong. They care about the message. [Well, I have a message, too. **I will never kneel. I will never bow to tyranny. I will never give away my rights.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1c09183b1e5f4eadbeb9656c3afff777&_e=-LmJksAJL26RdTyW3Tf5-JFeOJrUnKmKNqhrNm5ok9LuRkEyOh0Mwe-7-JtzzVzyRg9HncOYkBx7oKJZ1KzlPntZPoFi2qPkmRBzxiyXlJhCbbM-un8iRs1RWHkGbb5_LQf_OLOv647FeyWnipdDRC6lXPHgdYsgkqdZliJUlvzi7l_lbqci9G5CrXhl44qcOBU33KfGILxuk83huwlfz7c4pg9vNJntUyg7x604nyilF_pCqfIabxelq6cuI33jcnJzkDfCeuKX8mye_fYNZm1lMIzBOAL_najuwM-diejSLIBVDdDHXDeJjjjWParqW8XhxjhMp44cdkEM9hlrQWTomG4a1VXHub2lOAuAx2R1aiZXU9i-iURBEaExBGAqpjjEuEoehxSzIGqnAe7hgHCSzGU9kGMkdRTXtMcT12T9rVLZbdouXU2lugeItZSdKe0yrRQRtxIpqRAbYi3lf-jBMxh6KoFcBkyomAuiut4z3A19h2MwK_bL0F7LGZJT) This government is not about the machine. It's not about the swamp. This government is meant to serve the people, not suppress them. _The power to stop them is within our hands. It always has been. It is power we must use now. We must win in November. We must win now._ We've given away our liberty in drips and drabs...in exchange for peace of mind or the illusion of security.... We've been giving it away for the promise of safety in return... **But where they said safety, they meant control.** We are at a pivotal moment in our Republic. The yoke of the government has grown heavier than it has ever been, but built slowly enough that many haven't noticed. They simply keep moving. We cannot let another year compound. We must stand up and demand our freedom back. We must stop this backward descent from the very liberty that enabled every triumph in our nation's history. It stops with you. It stops with your help. Any donation, a dollar or a thousand. Whatever you can give: Every penny matters. The donations will allow us to keep up this fight, but just as importantly: Every single person who gives is another voice that won't go silent, another patriot standing up, another brick in the wall we are building to protect our freedom from those who wish to take it. _**I am not a politician. I never intended to run for office. I wanted to run my business. I wanted to raise my family. I wanted to serve God and live my faith.**_ When the government came and told me I could no longer do those things-- When they came and told us all that our church doors would be barred, that our businesses would be shut, that our kids couldn’t go to school... That was the day I knew I had to stand up. I am running for Governor because liberty for the People of the United States is not an idea I am willing to watch die without a fight. I am not willing to look back on my life and say... _...when our rights were challenged..._ _...when our freedom was being eroded...__...when the vision of my children’s future was being darkened and narrowed..._ ... I am not willing to look back and say I did anything less than everything. Everything. From the minute those agents were dispatched, this has been about a message... A message to me: To shut up, to sit down, that my life, my family, my freedom are theirs to threaten. But it's also a message to you. It's a message to every citizen. To every free soul. They're saying don't stand: Don't you dare stand up. Don't support patriots running for office. Don't refuse us. Don't speak up. Don't take off your mask. Don't disobey. Don't. **Their message is simple: Comply.** **My message is also simple: No.**
---

Donald J. Trump June 13th, 2022 Our nation is SUFFERING. Our economy is in the gutter. Inflation is rampant. Gas prices have reached an all-time high. Ships are unable to unload cargo. Families cannot get needed baby formula. We are an embarrassment around the world. Our withdrawal from Afghanistan was a disaster that cost us precious American blood, and gave $85 billion worth of the best military equipment on earth to our enemy. Millions and millions of illegals are marching to the border and invading our country. We have a White House in shambles, with Democrats, just this week, declaring that Biden is unfit to run for reelection. And what is the Democrat Congress focused on? A Kangaroo Court, hoping to distract the American people from the great pain they are experiencing. Seventeen months after the events of January 6th, Democrats are unable to offer solutions. | | With the close of the primary, I congratulate Mark Meuser on his strong performance and advancement to the California general election for U. S. Senate.

I congratulate all of the other candidates for U. S. Senate and other races for their personal effort and desire to serve in office for the great people of the United States.

Additionally, I thank everyone who helped my campaign along the way. From my announcement in January through the primary it has been an amazing experience!

>From those who assisted with administrative items, provided donations, made personal introductions, volunteered, coordinated and/or attended events, spoke positively on my behalf or simply provided words of encouragement and prayer for me to those more than 95,000 who trusted me with their precious vote, I offer my most sincere and boundless gratitude.

Each new relationship, personal effort and contribution stands as confirmation of my journey’s purpose. With every step your assistance helped me to walk boldly in my love for this great country and its great people.

As God continues to shape my use of this love in leadership and public service, I will remember you all and pray that you were in some way positively impacted by your interaction with me and participation in this phase of my journey.

As our country continues to struggle with the economy, an open border with drug and human trafficking, crime, failing education, and a weak posture in foreign policy, the American people are weary in motivation and hope and need strong candidates to win now! Let’s forge our full support for our prevailing candidates with a message that we will lead and implement specific plans to right the Country’s course. Let’s go win for the United States and its great people! Go Red!! Save the Red, White and Blue!!! Be Blessed,
Dr. Myron L. Hall

body:
Hi Team Geels,
_We are still looking for 2 volunteers for the 8pm-10pm shift._ Courtney and Bryan will be at the Festival all day with you. Will you consider manning the table along with Courtney & Bryan? It allows someone to go get a lemonade or go to the bathroom without leaving the table empty. It also allows for Courtney to talk to people while you hand out stuff and engage in any conversations.

_Shirts:_
Wear your shirt! If you don't have one, please consider making a $20 donation to Courtney's campaign on her website and contact Courtney directly to coordinate getting a shirt. That being said, we don't want a volunteer to go without one due to cost so let me know if you need one.

Golden Belt Campus Parking Lots

* Festival staff will show you to your designated booth space;

Phyllis Coley – NC Juneteenth State Director (cell: 919-697-0328)

name: Kina Collins
subject: Wow, I got the Chicago Tribune endorsement
body:
It's critical that we reach as many voters as we can right now with this momentum.
#
Peter, this is so, so big for our campaign.
**The Chicago Tribune, the largest newspaper in Chicago, endorsed me** in the Democratic primary for Illinois’ 7th Congressional District over a 25-year incumbent. The Tribune cited my leadership on gun violence prevention in Chicago and said it was time for a new generation of leadership in IL-7.
This is a major sign that we can win this race. **We have the momentum, Peter.** Now we need a rush of donations right now to overcome the massive corporate spending against our campaign.
[Can you split a donation to my campaign and Justice Democrats today? We have exactly two weeks before our primary and your contributions will help us reach more voters with early voting already underway.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110570?refcode=em20220614-23837&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23837%2E1203867%2ECqnTmi)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110570?refcode=em20220614-23837&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23837%2E1203867%2ECqnTmi)**
It is time to take on corporate power in Washington and truly fight to deliver for the working families of Illinois’ 7th Congressional District. That’s why I decided to run for Congress and that’s why I’ve worked so hard on this campaign to win against the big corporate money against me.
On an average weekday, 500,000 people see the Chicago Tribune. It’s very likely that we’ve picked up new voters after this endorsement and some people who are even first learning about our campaign. It’s critical that we reach as many voters as we can right now with this momentum.
Like the Tribune said, it’s time for a new generation of leaders in Congress. I’m ready to be part of that new generation and to fight for the people, if our grassroots supporters can step up and help us finish this campaign strong.
[Peter, can you chip in $3 to my campaign and Justice Democrats right now while we’ve got this momentum. Big corporate money is being spent against us and we must have the funds to lift our campaign at this crucial moment.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110570?refcode=em20220614-23837&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=23837%2E1203867%2ECqnTmi)
Thank you so much for your support.
In solidarity,
Kina Collins

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=23837%2E1203867%2ECqnTmi) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. | | Peter, Do you know what a misdemeanor is? It's commonly defined as a minor wrong doing. If you google it, you get something back like: _A misdemeanor is any "lesser" criminal act in some common law legal systems...Typically misdemeanors are punished with monetary fines or community service._ Do you know how many armed FBI agents usually get sent to arrest someone for a misdemeanor? **Zero. 0. None. Sending the FBI is an absurd way to handle a misdemeanor.** But that's exactly what they did. Biden's DOJ sent the FBI to my house. Armed men handcuffed me in front of my children and took me to jail, so they could charge me with misdemeanor trespassing. Just before sitting down to write you, I was on the radio talking with Steve Bannon. By now you must be asking the same question he did: _**why!?!?**_ Because it's not about justice. It's about politics and intimidation. I went to the Stop the Steal Rally on Jan 6th. I stood up against tyranny and exercised my right to demonstrate in the face of wrongdoing. This is the response. This is your government, your tax dollars, your nation bringing its boot down on the neck of its people. This is the bureaucracy bringing its weight down to try and push those who stand, back to their knees. __This is the way they senselessly scream**COMPLY.**__ It isn't about justice. It's about politics. It's about intimidation.
---
[**JOIN RYAN: STAND UP TO POLITICAL INTIMIDATION**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584748:6gV3ieouN:m:1:3253819041:B175950A911939CBF3AD24CC2303B550:r)
---
They knew when they sent armed federal agents to my house, it was for a press story. They knew any judge was likely to immediately release me. Which is exactly what happened. **They don't care. They don't care about the cost.** They don't care about right and wrong. They care about the message. [Well, I have a message, too. **I will never kneel. I will never bow to tyranny. I will never give away my rights.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584748:6gV3ieouN:m:1:3253819041:B175950A911939CBF3AD24CC2303B550:r) This government is not about the machine. It's not about the swamp. This government is meant to serve the people, not suppress them. _The power to stop them is within our hands. It always has been. It is power we must use now. We must win in November. We must win now._ We've given away our liberty in drips and drabs...in exchange for peace of mind or the illusion of security.... We've been giving it away for the promise of safety in return... **But where they said safety, they meant control.** We are at a pivotal moment in our Republic. The yoke of the government has grown heavier than it has ever been, but built slowly enough that many haven't noticed. They simply keep moving. We cannot let another year compound. We must stand up and demand our freedom back. We must stop this backward descent from the very liberty that enabled every triumph in our nation's history. It stops with you. It stops with your help. Any donation, a dollar or a thousand. Whatever you can give: Every penny matters. The donations will allow us to keep up this fight, but just as importantly: Every single person who gives is another voice that won't go silent, another patriot standing up, another brick in the wall we are building to protect our freedom from those who wish to take it. _**I am not a politician. I never intended to run for office. I wanted to run my business. I wanted to raise my family. I wanted to serve God and live my faith.**_ When the government came and told me I could no longer do those things-- When they came and told us all that our church doors would be barred, that our businesses would be shut, that our kids couldn't go to school... That was the day I knew I had to stand up. I am running for Governor because liberty for the People of the United States is not an idea I am willing to watch die without a fight. I am not willing to look back on my life and say... _...when our rights were challenged...__...when our freedom was being eroded...__...when the vision of my children 's future was being darkened and narrowed..._ ... I am not willing to look back and say I did anything less than everything. Everything. From the minute those agents were dispatched, this has been about a message... A message to me: To shut up, to sit down, that my life, my family, my freedom are theirs to threaten. But it's also a message to you. It's a message to every citizen. To every free soul. They're saying don't stand: Don't you dare stand up. Don't support patriots running for office. Don't refuse us. Don't speak up. Don't take off your mask. Don't disobey. Don't. **Their message is simple: Comply.** **My message is also simple: No.**
---
[**JOIN RYAN: STAND UP TO POLITICAL INTIMIDATION**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584748:6gV3ieouN:m:1:3253819041:B175950A911939CBF3AD24CC2303B550:r)
---
But I cannot stay standing forever alone. I need you. **[I need you to make a donation so that we have the resources needed to fight back.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584748:6gV3ieouN:m:1:3253819041:B175950A911939CBF3AD24CC2303B550:r)** There will be sleepless nights, there will be days in court, there will be rallies, there will be doors to knock...there will be work. I am not afraid of that. I am not afraid of doing the work...I am afraid of what happens if we don't do it. Please, I am asking you as plainly as I can: **[Click this link and make a donation right now. We need to do the work. We need your help.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60584748:6gV3ieouN:m:1:3253819041:B175950A911939CBF3AD24CC2303B550:r)**

In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. The question is: _What will you do next?_ Will you delete this email and go back to your day waiting around for them to take away your next freedom? Maybe your second and first amendment rights next? Or will you [click the link, make a donation, and be part of the true grassroots movement that is building here](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm710m3ojp76etuk3cv3ktomhloef5uk95kfjun0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5c9j61or2c5h2bs)? name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Fwd: Coming to you for feedback
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
Friend, I had to make sure you didn't miss the campaign strategy survey I sent you. The election is in full swing, and we're facing a Republican Party intent on wrestling back Senate control to pass an extreme agenda - Mitch McConnell has even said he is open to a federal abortion ban. I will fight with everything I have to keep that from happening, but I need 72 more members of this grassroots team to weigh in on campaign strategy, including you, Friend. Hearing what's on YOUR mind will help my campaign build a strategy that delivers progress for the American people and protects Democratic control of the Senate. **[So please, before my next meeting tomorrow morning, can you please make sure you've submitted your feedback? Click here to take our newest survey (it only takes about a minute!) right now.](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1196-su-nd)** Thank you for sharing your input. Dick
---
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Wed, Jun 8, 2022
Subject: Coming directly to you seeking feedback

[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=bPTKAx2G0m5XUmR8Cj7CAUbv6uhgkmmE&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
The days and weeks ahead will be critical for the future of our country:
* Any day now, the U.S. Supreme Court is likely to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , setting reproductive freedom back decades.
* Serious talks - with Republican participation - are finally underway in the Senate to pass gun violence prevention legislation that will begin to make a difference saving lives.

Yet Senate Democrats - including me - are facing an onslaught of political attacks from a Republican Party that knows that it only needs to flip one Democratic seat to put Mitch McConnell back in control of the Senate.
That's why my campaign is ramping up our efforts. These next several weeks are _critical_ to protecting this seat and addressing the urgent issues our country faces, which is why **I 'm coming directly to you seeking feedback that will help our strategy. **
**[Input from grassroots Democrats like you is essential to creating the kind of country we want to live in, so I'm asking directly: Will you please take just a moment to let me know what issues matter most to you? We just opened this new survey and are counting on 150 responses before midnight.](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1196-su-nd)**
I know that you hear from me a lot about the stakes of defending Senate control - but the urgency of preventing a Republican majority is crystal clear. GOP elected officials in the Senate, House, and across the country are calling for a _national abortion_ ban. They have forestalled any progress on action to reduce gun violence and save lives while continuing to accept _millions_ from the gun lobby.
Their agenda is extreme, dangerous, and not representative of the majority of Americans' priorities. **But my willingness to stand up against the Republican Party has made me a target. I know that the only way I can ensure the balance of power in the Senate is with the best possible campaign strategy - powered by people like you.**
**[So please, will you share your feedback on our newest strategy? We have a number of campaign strategy meetings coming up this week, and I want to make sure that this grassroots team's thoughts are well reflected. ](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1196-su-nd)**
Thank you,
Dick

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I am humbly asking you to make a $3 contribution to Giffords PAC to help pass this gun safety legislation.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Eleven years ago, a bullet changed my life forever.
#

Friends -
Eleven years ago, a bullet changed my life forever.
Six of my constituents were killed, several more injured. And Congress has failed to get anything done since.
But this week, our country took an important step forward with the announcement of a bipartisan framework on gun safety.
This bipartisan agreement on gun safety could be the first time in 30 years that Congress takes major action on gun safety.
Cynics said we couldn’t do it—they said the gun lobby was too strong. But make no mistake: This time will be different.
Why am I confident? Because in the 10 years since the shooting at Sandy Hook, we’ve built a movement of millions of Americans. We’ve passed hundreds of laws in state legislatures. We’ve invested millions in gun violence research and prevention. We’ve defeated the gun lobby at the ballot box.
But its passage is not guaranteed. Far from it.
Many details remain to be worked out and we can’t afford to lose any Senators along the way. I’ll be doing everything in my power to make sure we get it across the finish line, but I cannot do it alone.
So please:
[**I am humbly asking you to make a $3 contribution to Giffords PAC today. This bipartisan gun safety bill will save lives, and I need your help to make sure it passes and becomes law.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june22.JkdLIw&refcode=em220614-1-15&t=1&akid=2143%2E3935704%2EAQdPu-)

subject: A long shot
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John King for Governor, Eliza Leighton, Treasurer
body:
Some people — especially our opponents and establishment insiders — may say that a Black school teacher winning the governor’s mansion is a long shot, but the truth is my whole life has been a long shot.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46523291/350623765/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220614-fr_nd-JK_S2_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220614-fr_nd-JK_S2_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220614&&&&utm_content=fr_nd&&&&utm_term=JK_S2_C1&&&&amount=15&refcode2=8cd0d12e-25ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Y2QwZDEyZS0yNWVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oDW098lvKPxICmHmBcjd8uqF7NZcAFGBtPyqkYX1Mkk=) | Peter, **Some people — especially our opponents and establishment insiders — may say that a Black school teacher winning the governor’s mansion is a long shot, but the truth is my whole life has been a long shot. ** After my mom passed away when I was eight, I lived alone with my father who was suffering from undiagnosed Alzheimer’s disease. Growing up in an unstable household where I didn’t know what my dad would be like from one night to the next, I felt like I couldn’t really be a kid anymore. Instead of playing outside with friends, I was focused on getting food on the table, deciphering my dad’s moods, and balancing going to school with all I dealt with at home. Then, when I was 12, my dad also passed away. And like so many other kids who experience trauma, the loss of both my parents at such a young age left me truly angry at life’s circumstances. I was frustrated, heartbroken, and lonely, and I channeled all of these feelings by acting out — so much so that I was eventually kicked out of school. But the thing is, this story isn’t just mine. I share it with every kid who has ever been blindsided by trauma, exposed to violence, or lacked the support systems they need to succeed. However, I recognize that I am one of the lucky ones, and so many other struggling young kids — especially kids of color — don’t find a way to get back on track after such disruptive life experiences. Honestly, the only reason I didn’t end up in prison or even dead is because of public schools. I owe the change in the trajectory of my life to public school teachers and counselors who, when I was at my lowest, saw me for my whole potential and gave me a second chance. Without them, I wouldn’t be alive today. **I’m running for governor because every child deserves a second chance like I was given, and I have bold plans to make that vision a reality.** From making sure educators and parents have a seat at the table throughout the legislative process and policy implementation, to investing in more school counselors and mental health professionals at every public school, to focusing on recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce of educators, I will never compromise on equity, inclusion, and achievement for every single student. If you share my vision for Maryland’s future generations, I invite you to join our campaign. clean_body: Some people — especially our opponents and establishment insiders — may say that a Black school teacher winning the governor’s mansion is a long shot, but the truth is my whole life has been a long shot. = | Peter, Some people — especially our opponents and establishment insiders — may say that a Black school teacher winning the governor’s mansion is a long shot, but the truth is my whole life has been a long shot. After my mom passed away when I was eight, I lived alone with my father who was suffering from undiagnosed Alzheimer’s disease. Growing up in an unstable household where I didn’t know what my dad would be like from one night to the next, I felt like I couldn’t really be a kid anymore. Instead of playing outside with friends, I was focused on getting food on the table, deciphering my dad’s moods, and balancing going to school with all I dealt with at home. Then, when I was 12, my dad also passed away. And like so many other kids who experience trauma, the loss of both my parents at such a young age left me truly angry at life’s circumstances. I was frustrated, heartbroken, and lonely, and I channeled all of these feelings by acting out — so much so that I was eventually kicked out of school. But the thing is, this story isn’t just mine. I share it with every kid who has ever been blindsided by trauma, exposed to violence, or lacked the support systems they need to succeed. However, I recognize that I am one of the lucky ones, and so many other struggling young kids — especially kids of color — don’t find a way to get back on track after such disruptive life experiences. Honestly, the only reason I didn’t end up in prison or even dead is because of public schools. I owe the change in the trajectory of my life to public school teachers and counselors who, when I was at my lowest, saw me for my whole potential and gave me a second chance. Without them, I wouldn’t be alive today. I’m running for governor because every child deserves a second chance like I was given, and I have bold plans to make that vision a reality. From making sure educators and parents have a seat at the table throughout the legislative process and policy implementation, to investing in more school counselors and mental health professionals at every public school, to focusing on recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce of educators, I will never compromise on equity, inclusion, and achievement for every single student. name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: Fox News puts our troops in jeopardy
body:
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and CommonGood today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220614_CGVA_Franken]
Derek,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.
When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.
We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we’re still short. If we’re going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:
Please, will you split a donation of $27 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? I am so thankful to have you on the team,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

clean_body: | | | Friend, it’s Nikki Haley. I’ll make this quick. All eyes are on today's primaries. The results of these races will be used as a guide for what could follow in this year’s midterms. If Republicans show up to the polls in waves, it will be a huge blow to the Democrats’ hope of holding onto their majority. But if Republicans fail to show up to the polls, Democrats will leverage our loss for their own gain. I only need 25 patriots to step up to reach our goal. My very best, Nikki | A Note From Nikki: Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. Friends and Patriots!

We are excited to be participating in many parades this summer! Parades, fairs, and festivals are a great way to get the word out that we have a candidate willing to truly represent the people of the 2nd District! And they are fun a way to get involved!

There are many ways that you can help:

* Walk with us in a parade near you!
* Let us know of any parades or festivals in your community!
* Donate a Bag of Individually Wrapped Candy!!!!!!! Every bag brings smiles!

Please reach out today to make a difference in your area and help us Retire Pocan!

| | | Today marks the one-year anniversary of our campaign’s launch. I’m incredibly grateful for this community’s generous support, which has allowed us to knock on thousands of doors, meet voters at events all over this district, provide a meaningful challenge to Elise Stefanik, and build a grassroots network of volunteers.

To celebrate this landmark, I’d like to reflect on the message I shared with you on day one. My guiding principle remains the same today that it did at our campaign’s inception:_**I am driven to serve and to restore honorable leadership to my home.**_

Within the first 24 hours of launching, with your help, we raised just over $100,000. To continue to demonstrate the strength of our campaign and the demand for change, we have set a one-year anniversary goal of 1,000 contributions – of any amount, from first-time and recurring donors – in the next 24 hours.

We still face a challenging road ahead, but I’m so proud of the momentum we’re building as Election Day approaches.
---

Peter,

Great news!

**Republican House Leader Kevin McCarthy and the National Republican Congressional Committee have now named me one of their "Young Guns" for this critically important 2022 Midterm Election Nevada U. S. House race!**

The "Young Guns" program recognizes candidates in competitive congressional seats (like mine in NV-3) across the country who the national Republican Party believe can hold Democrats accountable, _and ultimately help flip the House._

This program will take our campaign to the HIGHEST level, providing advice, counsel and resources from Leader McCarthy and the national party. _It could make the difference between winning or losing this critical House race._

But being recognized for the principled stand I'm taking to bring commonsense conservative representation for our families and communities to Capitol Hill has put the national Democrats' target on my back, _too_.

Friend,

As the Supreme Court prepares its decision in regards to Dobbs v. Jackson and possibly the fate of Roe v. Wade **you can be assured that I will never stop fighting to defend the unborn and most innocent among us.**

Scripture reminds us that it is God Himself who forms and knits us together in the womb of our Mother (yes, I said Mother and not “birthing person”). As the mother of two beautiful children myself, I know that all human life is indeed a gift from God that we must defend and protect.
[](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=24fc0c39df6c47e095af54ee4bb5482f&_e=PZmX_IiDzKWstYzR1jq4LDleFBR8Q89zOtL8wAAQ2Abn4_lElsfrjmIvmptMyedRNG-nEhppoC9XjA4YSXn9-hmPgG__hO58KaY6hg-TXQzkD91A2PjTpojrZNvTke-u-k-FYEEPNIpf8mrKEQBSxG0lA4WNcioDFkeYFMn4P6MyZcTe0p0ot6h5vGjlJqnrM4c3donBdXk74DoSehIfpU0cgbu8vDeygCfkdkKrpWxobPfwzvlOrbtk1N70qF0GUzhobcNnTSQ8VLglCDGIMRZFliyzDhi-cjNJJHLXbD2hakm3F4S8tmG9VZVtngHsN1ZJLcgAAFvb_zt54479HLtoLJV3lGy5l1k0nZYt7N-6Zpz67L06CebrkG1Id9EEclR8TG4f8AC6QGDh9TGDvTavAXgqCr4RVMW3ZkBmAMB0pCG6g2zotT2on1RNvjNiyjICumZroFAYzTdPMlpQseJoO0XjpLsslieYfdBllDR516PfT524_hpTVyU_CXTdnAo7LPntfr-PGOvG1LvBIA%3D%3D)
We all know the Left and pro-abortion lobby have tried to make the voices of men irrelevant in this debate. I wholeheartedly disagree with this, but unfortunately, this is a tactic Abigail Spanberger is sure to use during the general election campaign.

**This is a card she won’t be able to use against me as I’ll go toe to toe with her defending life and the unborn this fall.**

As the most important Supreme Court decision in most of our lives could be handed down any day now we know that this issue will be front and center during this fall’s debate. We must not nominate someone who will shrink away from it.
[](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=24fc0c39df6c47e095af54ee4bb5482f&_e=PZmX_IiDzKWstYzR1jq4LDleFBR8Q89zOtL8wAAQ2Abn4_lElsfrjmIvmptMyedRNG-nEhppoC9XjA4YSXn9-hmPgG__hO58KaY6hg-TXQzkD91A2PjTpojrZNvTke-u-k-FYEEPNIpf8mrKEQBSxG0lA4WNcioDFkeYFMn4P6MyZcTe0p0ot6h5vGjlJqnrM4c3donBdXk74DoSehIfpU0cgbu8vDeygCfkdkKrpWxobPfwzvlOrbtk1N70qF0GUzhobcNnTSQ8VLglCDGIMRZFliyzDhi-cjNJJHLXbD23KQ7xoAlMutnmxxRPnTviIMSlka79JauXaNTIHruP7d-Bk76-kbFozwpJV_Qj_Y0Dd8jWWmTnpVVWOVV1oiSbAABeZo7LaAFwB72PpM6OWzT8tw2cg5khmAsris35s8MA4-6nFXjEvmQvhd9NRvtqr0K4nFuZZe8tPbjICyzw7p84gXhJUdRhfMmTGcXxGde-Di0oCkLsfHw0reOWjx5j_D-hoPXByRyYMKbuJKpOgg%3D%3D)
Of the three top contenders for this nomination,**I’m the only one who has even answered the National Pro-Life Alliance’s survey and answered it 100% in support of life - which is why they’ve endorsed me in this race.**

Like most issues, you know loud and clear where I stand. At this critical point in our nation’s history, the issue of defending innocent human life is too important not to take a firm position on or sit on the sidelines.

For Life,

Yesli Vega
Mother, Military Wife, Law Enforcement Officer

Wade you can be assured that I will never stop fighting to defend the unborn and most innocent among us. Scripture reminds us that it is God Himself who forms and knits us together in the womb of our Mother (yes, I said Mother and not “birthing person”). As the mother of two beautiful children myself, I know that all human life is indeed a gift from God that we must defend and protect. We all know the Left and pro-abortion lobby have tried to make the voices of men irrelevant in this debate. I wholeheartedly disagree with this, but unfortunately, this is a tactic Abigail Spanberger is sure to use during the general election campaign. This is a card she won’t be able to use against me as I’ll go toe to toe with her defending life and the unborn this fall. As the most important Supreme Court decision in most of our lives could be handed down any day now we know that this issue will be front and center during this fall’s debate. We must not nominate someone who will shrink away from it. Of the three top contenders for this nomination,I’m the only one who has even answered the National Pro-Life Alliance’s survey and answered it 100% in support of life - which is why they’ve endorsed me in this race. Like most issues, you know loud and clear where I stand. At this critical point in our nation’s history, the issue of defending innocent human life is too important not to take a firm position on or sit on the sidelines. For Life, Yesli Vega Mother, Military Wife, Law Enforcement Officer Early Voting Ends This Saturday! We’re five weeks into Election-Month-and-a-Half here in Virginia and early voting ends Saturday! Please to find your early voting location(s) in your jurisdiction. Endorsed by Jim Jordan and the House Freedom Caucus! | | ---|--- The momentum behind our campaign continues to grow as not only the most electable candidate in the general election campaign against Abigail Spanberger - but also the most principled from a conservative point of view. The type of people you have supporting you and in your corner is important. That’s why I’m honored to have received the endorsement and support of Congressman Jim Jordan and the campaign arm for the House Freedom Caucus. In the days of $30 Trillion in debt and a wide-open southern border, no group of individuals in the House have fought harder for border security and to stop the out-of-control-spending fueling the inflation crisis like the Freedom Caucus, and nobody holds corrupt Democrats administrations and liberal bureaucrats accountable quite like Jim Jordan. As we all know, our country is in serious trouble and it’ll require serious servants of the people willing to be the bad guy occasionally and say “No - enough is enough.” Other Republicans running for the nomination have said they won’t be a fiscal hawk in Congress. With $30 trillion-plus in debt, being anything less than a fiscal hawk should be disqualifying - especially if you’re running under the Republican banner. As the trusted steward of your tax dollars, you can be assured that I will treat your money as if it’s my very own and join the “bad guys” quite regularly in saying “No - enough is enough.” Endorsed by the Men and Women of U.S. Border Patrol This does not include those not stopped or detected which is typically similar in number. And of the two million stopped, almost half were allowed to proceed freely into the country because of the Biden administration’s insane return to catch and release. The intentional Biden/Spanberger border crisis is that on so many levels. They don’t care about the crime, they don’t care about the drugs, and they don’t care about the human sex trafficking. name: WelchForVermont.com
subject: We must act to make a higher education more attainable and affordable
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
We need to take action to get this done. Add your name if you agree.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=537%2E61531%2EN4GBBD)
Hello,
Around Vermont, and across the country, students of all kinds celebrated their commencement this spring. A time of celebration, it’s always such a joy to watch folks celebrate their hard work.
Education, especially higher education, is often the gateway to the American middle class. In many industries, bachelor’s or even master’s degrees are required for entry-level jobs. But as the price of college soars, Vermonters and people across the country are getting crushed by debt. For many, this means higher education feels out of reach.
Student debt is a problem—but it’s particularly bad in Vermont. Student debt is higher here—$37,000 a person—than the national average. That means it’s on us to act.
[**Right now, people are going into debt simply for pursuing a degree that many industries demand. It’s time we made higher education accessible to all and delivered relief. Add your name right away if you agree, and let’s work to make it happen.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-cancel-student-loan-debt/?source=em_20220614_p_t_studentdebt&t=9&akid=537%2E61531%2EN4GBBD)
As we continue to work to recover from the pandemic, it’s urgent we act. Short-term band-aids are not good enough, it’s clear people need long-term relief. One way to help is by canceling some student debt for certain borrowers, which would provide immediate relief to millions, work to close the racial wealth gap, and much more.
Peter’s been listening to Vermont students for years, and he’s heard about how they’re pushed into heavy debt to finish school. **Bottom line: we shouldn't saddle students with a lifetime of debt for simply pursuing a higher education.**
That’s why Peter continues to work to make higher education affordable and reduce the crushing burden of student loan debt. He’s fighting to increase access to community college, make debt-free public college a reality for all, and reduce the burden of student loans. He’s fighting to solve the student debt crisis today and make sure we don’t have another one on our hands tomorrow.
And we need to fight by his side.
[**If you agree it’s time to deliver relief to millions of Americans and make sure everyone can get an education without getting crushed by debt, add your name right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-cancel-student-loan-debt/?source=em_20220614_p_t_studentdebt&t=10&akid=537%2E61531%2EN4GBBD)
Thanks for taking action,
Team Welch

Statement by Donald J. Trump, 45th President of the United States of America
Our nation is SUFFERING. Our economy is in the gutter. Inflation is rampant. Gas prices have reached an all-time high. Ships are unable to unload cargo. Families cannot get needed baby formula. We are an embarrassment around the world. Our withdrawal from Afghanistan was a disaster that cost us precious American blood, and gave $85 billion worth of the best military equipment on earth to our enemy. Millions and millions of illegals are marching to the border and invading our country. We have a White House in shambles, with Democrats, just this week, declaring that Biden is unfit to run for reelection. And what is the Democrat Congress focused on? A Kangaroo Court, hoping to distract the American people from the great pain they are experiencing. Seventeen months after the events of January 6th, Democrats are unable to offer solutions. They are desperate to change the narrative of a failing nation, without even making mention of the havoc and death caused by the Radical Left just months earlier. Make no mistake, they control the government. They own this disaster. They are hoping that these hearings will somehow alter their failing prospects. A certain Democrat once said, “It's the economy, stupid.” Well, Democrats now seem to think that Americans are “stupid.” They are not. America is crumbling, and Democrats have no solutions. Our nation has no hope of change for the better under Democrat leadership. People are desperate. Rather than solving problems, Democrats are rehashing history in hopes of changing the narrative. During my time in office, our nation was thriving, our economy was strong, and the price of gas was very low. Above all else, we were respected, perhaps like never before. America prospered under the Trump Administration. He’ll treat this violence like the crisis it is.”_

_“For too long, our students have been promised an equal opportunity, but politicians have failed. We must do better. As governor, my plan tackles these disparities in education: free pre-K for kids in need, schools funded in a fair and equitable way, and all of our schools must be safe. We can't settle for the same old politics or policies.This is our moment to give every student a fair shot at success.”_

Peter, Today is the day we celebrate the stars and stripes that illustrate the valor, perseverance and purity that are woven into our American spirit. Our spangled banner yet waves – _one flag for one people, united in pursuit of liberty_. **We are honored to count you as a fellow patriot who supports our flag and those who sacrificed so much for its stripes...** [**Click or press here to add your name to the list of patriots****🇺🇸 >>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/282e4263e04f74c17c94c760ea83e7c0/34143/4c17621afc1a3f91/81567d0c5c030e5ac3d6b838967d376c/34143)

---
The nation’s emblem has a story of humble origins, but its storied legacy lives on in the American men and women who carry freedom’s standard forward. Our flag stood resolute in the face of tyranny, battered and barraged as liberty’s enemies have looked to quell the land of the free and home of the brave. When evil has come knocking at our door, **the red, white and blue knocked back harder** , upstanding in its posture, unyielding in the hands of American patriots. It is a woven testament to trial, tribulation, and triumph – a promise for all good men and women to stand and fight when the going gets tough... _We the People get tougher_. Thank you for standing with us during this historic time in America, and for honoring the flag that unites us ALL. For America, Team Hern

clean_body: We must protect and expand our razor-thin Democratic majorities so we can defend our democracy. | | | I’m paying very close attention to the House select committee’s January 6 hearings. We need to call out the traitors who embraced the Big Lie and incited a violent insurrection against our country. And can’t let them cover up the details of their plot. The House hearings are powerfully important so we can get the facts and ensure accountability. Understand this: The attempt to overturn the 2020 election was part of an ongoing scheme to stop the American people from being able to choose our country’s leaders. We must get to the bottom of what happened, and defend the right to vote and the right to have that vote counted. It is the only way to secure our democracy. So that means we have to tackle GOP voter suppression head-on. And we have to fight back against Republican candidates who are still spreading the Big Lie to kiss up to Donald Trump, who still won’t admit that he lost an election fair and square. Cowards like Republican House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy have flip-flopped from their private conversations shortly after January 6, when they talked about standing up to Trump. But now they’re solidly behind him, no matter what. These hearings are yet another reminder that we can’t let Kevin McCarthy and the Republicans take back control in this year’s midterm elections. | _Compassion, n._
1. _A feeling of deep sympathy and sorrow for another who is stricken by misfortune, accompanied by a strong desire to alleviate the suffering._
2. _A trait possessed by Kathleen Brown, candidate for Texas’ 13th Congressional District._
3. _An emotion unknown to Ronny Jackson._

It’s true – compassion is an emotion unknown to Ronny Jackson. Just look at the malicious policies Ronny Jackson supports and the hateful rhetoric he spews.

When I’m your representative, I will govern with compassion and fight to truly uplift you and your family. [**Will you help make this a reality by donating $15, $25, or $50?**](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=2e7cac4a0f&e=4712f71bea)

| I know we are living through scary times as reproductive rights are stripped and violence becomes more prevalent in our communities. This is especially true as Ronny Jackson fights to “return to Trump policies” here in Texas.

That’s why I am committed to working tirelessly to create a safe future where **your rights and freedoms are protected.**

[Can I count on you to contribute to a **compassionate and hardworking** campaign today?](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=dd6c1f4556&e=4712f71bea)

Thank you for your support. I am running for office because of you, and I will never stop fighting to create a better future for you and our Texas communities.

body:
Happy Flag Day!

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=flag_day&n=1)
---
Friend -- **Our flag.** It stands for freedom, it stands for liberty, and it stands for a country that we love.

On this day in 1777, our star-spangled banner was adopted as the flag for this great nation. At this time, our founding fathers were fighting relentlessly to build a nation of freedom in a world where freedom wasn’t valued **– our flag stood for freedom when it wasn’t popular.** At the height of the civil war, our flag stood for unity and freedom for all people in this great nation. The Republican Party started in Wisconsin as a group of abolitionists who were proud to raise this flag **– our flag stood for unity in a nation that was completely divided.** Time and time again, our flag stands for our American values, even when and ESPECIALLY when those values are under attack. Now is no different. For far too long, the left has been disrespecting our flag, disregarding our national anthem, and making a mockery of our great country. Our flag did not prevail through countless tribulations to be a subject of the radical left’s insanity. Friend, we must put a **stop** to their madness by electing no-nonsense Conservative leaders who will defend this great nation. If you’d like to help us stand up to the radical left, sign up to volunteer [here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=flag_day&n=2) or make a financial contribution [here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhQ7s4NVMPMWV_ynhmfPHjSk42bNSplnAqMcbO1tQOdk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=flag_day&n=3). | I think the attributes that Ally Isom brings to the game are completely unique to her, and I believe she will represent our state with grace and dignity.

I am just one of the many lucky people who chose to move to Utah during the pandemic. I think she'll represent Utah beautifully in the Senate.

subject: #TeamLizzie Weekly Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:

This week, we are focused on the work and the progress that our work together brings.
Back in 2018, when Lizzie took on a nine-term incumbent member of Congress with an A+ rating from the NRA, she wasn’t afraid to talk about common-sense gun safety and make it a key part of her campaign, confident that — despite what others might think — Texans understand the risks and want a common-sense approach. She also campaigned on making our community in Houston safer from catastrophic flooding and storms, especially after Hurricane Harvey devastated our area during that first campaign.
Over the last week, we have seen the result of our work to get her elected — as the House passed two important bills with her support and efforts.
CBS News:
“House passes package of gun control bills in response to Buffalo and Uvalde shootings”
June 9, 2022
Last week, Lizzie co-sponsored and voted for a gun-safety package that would raise the minimum age for buying a semiautomatic rifle, ban large-capacity magazines, ensure safe storage of firearms, close bump stock loopholes, and strengthen regulations for ghost guns.
The families and survivors of the Uvalde school shooting — and everyone who has experienced gun violence in their communities — deserve solutions to the violence that has forever changed their lives.
Lizzie is determined to continue this work to make our communities safer and to make sure gun violence doesn’t become our new normal.
The Texas Tribune:
“U.S. House approves massive $31 billion ‘Ike Dike’ project to protect Texas coast from hurricanes”
June 9, 2022
Keeping us safe during storms is also important, and Lizzie has been advocating for and working to pass a plan to do that on the Gulf Coast. Last week, the House authored the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers transformative plan for coastal protection and restoration along the Texas coast — including the “Ike Dike” — which will protect the Houston Ship Channel and fortify Texas’ coast against hurricanes and rising sea levels.
Lizzie has worked to show her colleagues from across the country that this project is not only a big win for Houston and Texas, but for our entire country, as our port is a major economic driver for our nation’s economy and security. Another promise kept.
This weekend, we will celebrate Juneteenth, a holiday that reminds us of our ability to make progress and the importance of continuing our work to do so.
This week, we saw that work in action, and are so glad to share it with our entire team.
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

#
Hello Peter Willis,

Yesterday, I shared a little about how I started my political journey from a tumultuous divorce. The divorce was a tough time in my life, but it helped make me who I am today. I found out I was more than an insurance agent during that divorce. I realized that I am an advocate for the people, and my voice is needed. When I worked in the insurance industry, I heard many heart-wrenching stories. I spoke to the widowed wives whose husbands' couldn't afford health insurance and didn't have life insurance, so they were left with medical bills while providing for their children on one income. I also remember the man who couldn't earn a livable wage to feed his family. One story that stayed in my heart was about the sweet grandmother who lived alone and feared for her safety that she had a gun in every room of her house. Stories that made me realize that American society needed a change. Many American citizens desperately need someone to be there for them. They needed someone to be their voice. After moving to Georgia, I started taking on more roles to make a difference. I was an elected officer, appointed board member, and committee chair for several organizations such as the Statesboro Regional Library Board, C.A.S.A. Board (Court Appointed Special Advocates for Children), Statesboro Noon Lions Club, Habitat for Humanity, and a school board zoning taskforce. I took these roles very seriously. I wanted to do more and educate the voters about each elected seat, its role, and how to ensure the person elected benefits the voters. So, I became a political leader and served at the county, district, and state committee levels of the Democratic Party of Georgia for over 20 years. I also served as one of six Democratic National Committee members representing Georgia after being elected by my state committee peers. I loved serving in these roles but knew I had more to offer Georgia. So in 2014, twenty years after my Florida bid, I made a bid for Georgia Insurance Commissioner. This bid made me among the few women of color to gain a major party nomination for a statewide executive office! I received over 1 million votes statewide that November, giving me a well-recognized name in Georgia politics. People have asked me how I can do all of these things, but for me, the fear doesn't set in until everything is over. I knew it was time to go all the way! In 2020, with 84% of the Democratic Primary votes, I came close to winning the U.S. House of Representatives seat in Georgia's 12th Congressional District. But I won't give up! I am on the ballot once again in 2022 as a Democrat for the U.S. House of Representatives in Georgia's 12th district. I hope you can tell how excited I am to serve as your next U.S. House of Representative! I would love to share a short video of my campaigns over the years with you. I hope it inspires you to think about the fear after you have accomplished your goals. [CLICK HERE to watch.](https://lizjohnsonforus.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4a0fd0913238344008dfe952&id=1970678ede&e=e8eaba4639) I will tell you more about my campaign for a seat in congress in 2022 tomorrow. I can't wait to share this with you because I have life-changing plans! I also have something special planned for you in the next two weeks, and I can't wait to tell you what it is!
With much gratitude, Elizabeth "Liz" Johnson Lizjohnsonforus.com

subject: The reason Alexandria doesn’t do call time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Alexandria’a ability to continue sharing vital information with her 8.5 million followers and growing our movement depends on all of us pitching in with small-dollar donations.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220614-3103-header&t=1&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX)
Most Members of Congress spend many hours every day fundraising for re-election. That often includes being on the phone with donors for hours each day.
It’s called “Call Time” and is considered part of the job.
**But because people like you support Alexandria with small-dollar digital donations, she doesn’t do “call time.”** Instead, she can spend her time answering your questions and sharing key information.
If you’ve been following Alexandria on Instagram, you may have seen that she’s been using the platform to share _lots_ of key behind-the-scenes information on topics ranging from the future of Puerto Rico to gun control, and what to expect as a first-time voter.
**Alexandria’a ability to continue sharing vital information with her 8.5 million followers and growing our movement depends on all of us pitching in with small-dollar donations.** We need her time spent breaking down major issues and what’s going on in Congress – not fundraising.
[If you’re able to, can you pitch in $5, $15 or $50 today so that Alexandria has the time to focus on what matters – growing our movement and bringing more people in to what’s happening in D.C.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220614.8Jcl6m&refcode=em20220614-3103-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220614.8Jcl6m&refcode=em20220614-3103-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX)**
Just take a look at her response to someone’s question about how she’s able to share such detailed responses to questions she receives through Instagram stories:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220614.8Jcl6m&refcode=em20220614-3103-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX)
Everything you see on there is directly from Alexandria. No staff, just her – sharing her honest thoughts and experiences as the youngest member of Congress in history.
Alexandria is always looking for new ways to break through the barriers of “old-school” media to engage more people in politics – especially young people. It’s why she hosted a livestream on Twitch where she reached 435,000 viewers to get out the vote – which became one of the platforms 20 biggest streams ever.1
It’s why she regularly hosts Instagram Lives after major events to break down what’s going on and how you can help.
**And all of this is only possible because she has the time to do it instead of making calls to wealthy donors.**[If you’re able to, please pitch in whatever you can to help power Alexandria’s re-election without call time. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220614.8Jcl6m&refcode=em20220614-3103-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX)
Thank you for all of your support. It’s truly what makes it all possible.
– Team AOC
P.S. If you’re looking for an easy and fun way to keep a pulse on what’s happening and to share your questions with Alexandria directly, [**please follow @AOC on Instagram here**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/1668?t=24&akid=3103%2E2526796%2E6O66fX).

clean_body: Alexandria’a ability to continue sharing vital information with her 8.5 million followers and growing our movement depends on all of us pitching in with small-dollar donations. Most Members of Congress spend many hours every day fundraising for re-election. That often includes being on the phone with donors for hours each day. It’s called “Call Time” and is considered part of the job. But because people like you support Alexandria with small-dollar digital donations, she doesn’t do “call time.” Instead, she can spend her time answering your questions and sharing key information. If you’ve been following Alexandria on Instagram, you may have seen that she’s been using the platform to share lots of key behind-the-scenes information on topics ranging from the future of Puerto Rico to gun control, and what to expect as a first-time voter. Alexandria’a ability to continue sharing vital information with her 8.5 million followers and growing our movement depends on all of us pitching in with small-dollar donations. We need her time spent breaking down major issues and what’s going on in Congress – not fundraising. Just take a look at her response to someone’s question about how she’s able to share such detailed responses to questions she receives through Instagram stories: Everything you see on there is directly from Alexandria. No staff, just her – sharing her honest thoughts and experiences as the youngest member of Congress in history. Alexandria is always looking for new ways to break through the barriers of “old-school” media to engage more people in politics – especially young people. It’s why she hosted a livestream on Twitch where she reached 435,000 viewers to get out the vote – which became one of the platforms 20 biggest streams ever.1 It’s why she regularly hosts Instagram Lives after major events to break down what’s going on and how you can help. And all of this is only possible because she has the time to do it instead of making calls to wealthy donors. Thank you for all of your support. It’s truly what makes it all possible. – Team AOC P.S. body:
Taking on the well-funded special interests that try to buy elections for DC insiders like Ted Budd is a tall order.
#

When we won the primary, Mitch McConnell’s PAC had just booked at least $33 million in TV ads to spend against us, and the NRSC was already on the air attacking me — the first challenger anywhere in the country.
I knew all of the data said this race would be one of the most competitive races in the entire country — setting it up to be one of the most expensive races as well. Taking on the well-funded special interests that try to buy elections for DC insiders like Ted Budd is a tall order.
But within MINUTES of our race being called, support poured in from everywhere.
Emily, a physician assistant in Raleigh, donated $20.22 to help us win in November. Then a retiree in Brevard named Peter made his $100 donation recurring to sustain our campaign, and Susan, an educator in Morehead City, pitched in her $5!
Just like that, we were off, and the people were with us saying they were ready to fight to flip this seat.
And that’s what it is going to take to flip this seat — thousands of people just like you stepping up to own a piece of this fight. So I need to ask for your support today:

Hey folks,
Today is a HUGE day for Team Engel. You may have already seen it, but our first ad just went on air! Reaching out to the hundreds of thousands of voters here in the AZ-06 takes a lot of resources, and we were only able to do it with the help of our grassroots supporters. You can watch the new ad here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_061422_NewAd] , and I hope you will make a contribution to help us keep the momentum going!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_061422_NewAd [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_061422_NewAd]
I am so happy my daughter Helene joined me in the video. Like all of our kids, she has so many questions about where our country is heading. And as the direction of this country has changed over the years, those questions have become harder and harder to answer.
That is why I am running for Congress. Not only because we face an existential threat to the environment. Not only because our democracy is under assault by the GOP. Not only because women’s access to healthcare is about to be set back 50 years. But also because our children and ALL Americans deserve answers to these questions, and they deserve a government that is working hard to find solutions.
But folks, I still need your help. Tucson is one of the most expensive media markets in the country, and we still need help to make sure we are able to continue to speak to voters on the airways from now through election day. Can you make a contribution today to make sure we are able to keep talking to voters? With our biggest filing deadline yet at the end of the month, every dollar counts. | | | Derek, __Do you have a few moments? Our campaign has been making waves here in New Hampshire, leading in the polls and building support in every corner of the state. And I want to take the time to tell you what it’s all about - here’s just some of what I’m fighting for: **#1: It’s time we****MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN****and combat the inflation that’s skyrocketing as a result of Biden and Hassan’s out-of-control spending.** The rising prices are at a 40-year high with no end in sight, and we have these Democrats in Washington to blame for their complete lack of fiscal discipline at a federal level. We need real solutions that both tackle the causes and provide immediate relief. As someone who balanced budgets here in NH, I’m ready to do just that. **#2: We need to Back the Badge and Support Our Law Enforcement now more than ever.** Violent crime is on the rise all across the country, and yet some of the radicals in Maggie Hassan’s party are calling for us to Defund the Police. I have always supported law enforcement, and will be a champion for them in the U.S. Senate. **#3: We can’t let Parents’ Rights end at their child’s classroom door.** Parents have the power to bring about political change, and here in New Hampshire, we listened to them with victories for School Choice and more. I will continue to stand up for parents in D.C., because unlike Maggie Hassan, I listen to their input instead of the demands of the teacher’s unions. **#4: It’s time we finally Secure the Border.** The results of Maggie Hassan’s support for the Biden Open Borders policies are being felt in New Hampshire everyday with a daily surge of fentanyl. We need to secure the border, finish building President Trump’s Wall, put America First, and keep our streets safe!****

Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [On to November](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziopVSgEi8wx4YB6RHMJxrzeD2gdFkU54x5tGh9_VMcFstg&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june14_2022_final&n=1) As vote-counting continues, our margin in last Tuesday’s Primary has grown beyond what anyone expected. For those who said a grassroots campaign couldn’t succeed, we have shown otherwise in a resounding way. You can watch my Election Night speech [here](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQzioq3FFwg4jMIJbkQNyOaFpYmhcKhUK6uI2CzqjikiM0cES6wWsGlPIo-0vfgN11Sse0&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june14_2022_final&n=2). Across the state, it was a good night overall. Some other notable results:
* The District Attorney of San Francisco was recalled, and LA’s DA is likely next. This also suggests that the race for California Attorney General is winnable; it appears Nathan Hochman has advanced to take on Newsom-appointee Rob Bonta.

* Republican Lanhee Chen got the most votes for State Controller. This is a race to keep an eye on. Lanhee is a strong candidate who would rein in the Supermajority.

* It’s still too close to call who will challenge Tony Thurmond for Superintendent of Public Instruction, but it appears most likely to be Lance Christensen – a strong school choice advocate who I’ve endorsed.

* The Republican nominees for the other statewide offices appear to be settled. Governor: Brian Dahle. Lt. Governor: Angela Jacobs. Treasurer: Jack Guerrero. Secretary of State: Rob Bernosky. Insurance Commissioner: Robert Howell.

* One frustrating result: a solidly Republican State Senate seat has been lost. Because of a fluke of the Top 2 Primary, two Democrat candidates advanced. This is why I’ve drafted legislation to get rid of Top 2.

As for our race going forward, the November General Election against the Democrat will be a battle. But thanks to our showing in the Primary – thanks to your tremendous support – we are now in the driver’s seat. Friend –

Last week, I took to the Senate floor to ask: When will we say enough? 21 victims in Uvalde, Texas. 17 killed at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School. 20 dead in Newtown, Connecticut. 12 students murdered at Columbine. The list gets longer every year.

Gun violence continues to kill our children every single day, and we cannot wait any longer to act.

I'm heartened by the efforts of my colleagues Senator Murphy and Senator Cornyn to put forward a bipartisan agreement on gun violence – the first in decades. We must get this done now for the American people.

Will you add your name to join me in supporting this breakthrough agreement to save lives and keep our communities safe?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.com/els/v2/LE64hN~YX0tK/ampLMllWVExPbnJXQU9CRkx1V0lQNFhONFB3Wm9xSjIwT2gzT3Y0aFBaSHBIb1NTYldZM3FDYmNxbmFzRWsvU3VxejVUbmpRUUIxYXE5OGtCNG1TeUxnb1JHSFI5Z1F3N0x1NHVIVU14YzA9S0/b2R4MEc5TmQzWGhMRTcwcFo1WmhucVdCYms0TVVkS1l0cUtaQmFTZXhLUFNCTlZIdjVwTm5NNDRnYVhVT1Y1aFRaamorY05wbFR1WGcwRW5nRWdTbDc3aElwMjkvVjRPS0

This commonsense deal takes up key elements of my bipartisan straw purchasing bill, as well as additional practical measures to keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals.

To start, the agreement would allocate significant funding to support states in enacting red flag laws, which will allow folks' loved ones or the police to prevent individuals from accessing or purchasing firearms.

Additionally, the framework of the agreement will provide billions in funding for mental health and school safety – including a national build-out of community mental health clinics. Significantly, it would prevent anyone convicted of domestic abuse from purchasing a firearm and enhance background check requirements for those under 21.

Alone, this agreement will not be sufficient to end our nation's epidemic of gun violence. But it is a heartening step forward, and I do believe that these commonsense policy measures will help save lives.

Now, we must get this legislation drafted post-haste, passed through both chambers, and onto President Biden's desk to sign. Let's collectively say: Enough is enough.

Add your name right now to join me in supporting this bipartisan agreement on gun violence.

clean_body: Friend – Last week, I took to the Senate floor to ask: When will we say enough? 21 victims in Uvalde, Texas. 17 killed at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School. 20 dead in Newtown, Connecticut. 12 students murdered at Columbine. The list gets longer every year. Gun violence continues to kill our children every single day, and we cannot wait any longer to act. I'm heartened by the efforts of my colleagues Senator Murphy and Senator Cornyn to put forward a bipartisan agreement on gun violence – the first in decades. We must get this done now for the American people. Will you add your name to join me in supporting this breakthrough agreement to save lives and keep our communities safe? This commonsense deal takes up key elements of my bipartisan straw purchasing bill, as well as additional practical measures to keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals. To start, the agreement would allocate significant funding to support states in enacting red flag laws, which will allow folks' loved ones or the police to prevent individuals from accessing or purchasing firearms. Additionally, the framework of the agreement will provide billions in funding for mental health and school safety – including a national build-out of community mental health clinics. Significantly, it would prevent anyone convicted of domestic abuse from purchasing a firearm and enhance background check requirements for those under 21. Alone, this agreement will not be sufficient to end our nation's epidemic of gun violence. But it is a heartening step forward, and I do believe that these commonsense policy measures will help save lives. Now, we must get this legislation drafted post-haste, passed through both chambers, and onto President Biden's desk to sign. Let's collectively say: Enough is enough. Add your name right now to join me in supporting this bipartisan agreement on gun violence. Sincerely, Patrick Leahy U.S. Senator ADD YOUR NAME »
